paper.title: MixFormer: Linear Transformer with Mixture of Memory Experts
paper.abstract: State Space Models (SSMs), as a mainstream research direction of linear Transformers, aim to achieve higher efficiency than standard Transformers in long-context modeling. However, existing SSMs suffer from limited input adaptivity and constrained memory capacity, leading to information loss when modeling ultra-long sequences. To address these limitations, we propose MixFormer, a novel linear Transformer that integrates a Mixture-of-Memory-Experts (MoE) mechanism. Specifically, the model maintai

summary.core_problem: 解决 SSM/线性 Transformer 在超长序列中输入自适应不足、记忆容量有限和历史信息稀释的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是长上下文架构改进，方向与 linear attention、SSM 和 memory-augmented Transformer 相关。摘要中的设计有一定可读性，但缺少模型规模、训练 token、强 baseline 和真实 LLM 预训练结果信息，当前更像早期架构提案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MixFormer，引入 Mixture-of-Memory-Experts。模型维护多个差异化 memory states，并通过 Time-Aware Linear Attention 使用可学习指数衰减函数和位置偏置动态更新记忆，从而选择性强化重要历史信息、缓解 memory dilution。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在长序列文本和图像生成任务上验证，目标是提升长程依赖建模。未给出参数规模、训练数据规模、对比模型、速度/显存曲线或具体提升幅度；这些决定其是否对 LLM 预训练有实际意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets limited input adaptivity, constrained memory capacity, and memory dilution in SSM-like or linear-Transformer long-context models.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an architecture proposal for long-context modeling, related to linear attention, SSMs, and memory-augmented Transformers. The idea is relevant, but the abstract lacks scale, token budget, strong baselines, and full LLM pretraining evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: MixFormer introduces a Mixture-of-Memory-Experts mechanism. It maintains multiple differentiated memory states and uses Time-Aware Linear Attention with learnable exponential decay functions and positional biases to dynamically update memory and reinforce important historical information.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on long-sequence text and image generation tasks. It does not provide model sizes, training data, concrete baselines, speed-memory tradeoffs, or effect sizes, which are essential for judging relevance to LLM pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 作为线性注意力记忆设计备查；先看是否有真实语言预训练和吞吐曲线，没有就不必投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for linear-attention memory design; first check for real LM pretraining and throughput curves before spending time.

paper.title: Recurrent Neural Networks Beyond Time: Learning from Multiple Ordered Projections
paper.abstract: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are widely used for sequence learning, yet their application is commonly associated with temporal data, although recurrent computation fundamentally operates on ordered sequences rather than on time itself. Building on this observation, we introduce the Ordered Structural Dependency Hypothesis (OSDH), which proposes that multiple admissible orderings of the same observations may reveal complementary structural dependencies inaccessible through a single sequential

summary.core_problem: 传统RNN被局限于时间序列场景，未挖掘同一数据的多种合法有序投影带来的互补结构信息
summary.importance: 提出新的序列建模假设与架构原则，拓展了RNN类模型的适用边界，属于序列建模范式的小幅度方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出有序结构依赖假设(OSDH)与独立结构专家原则(ISEP)，实现SE-RNN：对同一数据的多种合法排序分别训练独立的原生RNN专家，再通过专用融合模型整合表示，核心RNN计算逻辑未做修改
summary.experiments: 摘要截断，仅提及为概念验证，未披露具体参数量、数据集、基线模型与量化实验结果

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional RNNs are narrowly tied to temporal data, failing to exploit complementary structural information from multiple valid orderings of the same input observations
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel sequence modeling hypothesis and architectural principle, expanding the applicability of RNN-family models, categorized as minor methodological innovation in sequence modeling paradigms
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Ordered Structural Dependency Hypothesis (OSDH) and Independent Structural Expert Principle (ISEP); implements SE-RNNs by training separate vanilla RNN experts on each admissible input ordering, then fusing their representations via a dedicated fusion module without modifying core recurrent computation
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; only proof-of-concept is mentioned, with no disclosed parameter counts, datasets, baselines or quantitative results

recommendation.zh: 序列排序多样性的思路可作架构灵感参考，但无大模型验证，仅备查，无需读正文
recommendation.en: The ordering diversity idea is usable as architecture inspiration, but no large-scale validation; keep for reference, no need to read full text

paper.title: MDLMPE: Distribution Aware Positional Encoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) enable parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling, but their positional context differs fundamentally from that of autoregressive (AR) models. Whereas AR decoding exposes a contiguous prefix, MDLM denoising produces dynamic, non-contiguous configurations of revealed and masked tokens. Conventional positional encodings such as RoPE capture sequence order and pairwise displacement but remain insensitive to this evolving token-availability struct

summary.core_problem: 论文解决 masked diffusion language model 的位置编码错配问题：MDLM 生成时可见 token 分布是动态、非连续的，而 RoPE 只编码绝对位置和相对位移，不能表达某个位置周围哪些 token 当前已经可见。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对新型语言建模范式有启发。LLaDA、DREAM 等 MDLM 已经证明 masked denoising 可以扩到较大模型，但很多组件仍沿用 AR LLM 的设计。MDLMPE 指出位置编码不应只看 index，还应看当前 denoising state。这个方向重要，因为 MDLM 的主要优势来自并行和任意顺序生成；如果位置编码仍假设连续 prefix，就会限制这种范式的建模效率。
summary.technical_approach:
MDLMPE 把每一步 denoising 的可见/遮盖状态显式做成位置条件。具体做法是先构造一个 binary availability sequence，标记哪些位置是已揭示 token，哪些位置仍是 mask 或 attention-invalid。然后对每个 target position 使用 target-centered Gaussian weighting，形成一个以目标位置为中心的可见 token 分布表示。对 attention pair，方法会把两个 token 的 centered view 平均成 joint distribution，用来描述这对 token 之间共享的上下文可用性。

为了把这个分布接入模型，作者使用 cosine-basis projection 把可见性模式投影成特征。MDLMPE 有两条路径：token-level features 加到 embedding 或 residual 输入中，pair-level features 经过轻量 MLP 后转成 RoPE 的 angular offsets。这样既保留 RoPE 的相对位置结构，又让旋转角度随 mask pattern 改变。它和 LongLLaDA、UltraLLaDA 这类长上下文 RoPE 改造不同；后者主要处理长度外推，MDLMPE 处理的是同一长度内可见 token 分布随 denoising 动态变化的问题。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两类场景。第一类是在已有较大 MDLM checkpoint 上做 post-training，模型包括 LLaDA 和 DREAM，规模为 7B/8B，训练数据包括 Tulu 和 SmolTalk。作者报告在知识、推理和代码任务上多数指标有提升，其余任务大体持平。第二类是更受控的 100M 参数预训练和 zero-shot evaluation，用来验证 MDLMPE 不是只依赖大模型 checkpoint 或特定 post-training 数据。

论文还做了 block diffusion 和组件消融。消融的重点是 token feature path、pair feature path、Gaussian-centered availability representation、cosine projection 与 RoPE offset 的组合关系。可带走的实验结论是：只给模型一个 [MASK] token identity 不够；显式提供可见 token 的空间分布，可以改善 denoising 时对上下文证据位置的利用。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 AR prefix 与 MDLM non-contiguous denoising 的对比图，以及 Method 中 binary availability、Gaussian weighting、cosine-basis projection、RoPE angular offset 的定义。实验部分建议优先看 LLaDA/DREAM 的 matched post-training 表格和 100M controlled pretraining 消融。若关注 diffusion LM 的架构设计，可以深挖 pair-level RoPE offset：这是论文真正把动态 mask pattern 接入 attention 几何的位置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a positional-encoding mismatch in masked diffusion language models. During MDLM decoding, the set of visible tokens is dynamic and often non-contiguous, while standard RoPE only represents token indices and pairwise displacement. It does not tell the model where usable context currently exists.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to alternative language-modeling objectives. Models such as LLaDA and DREAM have shown that masked denoising can scale, but many architectural choices are still inherited from autoregressive LLMs. MDLMPE makes a precise point: position in an MDLM is not just an index; it is an index under a particular revealed/masked configuration. This matters because the parallel and flexible generation behavior of MDLMs depends on using non-prefix context effectively.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MDLMPE explicitly conditions positional representations on the denoising state. It starts from a binary availability sequence indicating which positions contain revealed tokens and which positions are masked or attention-invalid. For each target token, a target-centered Gaussian weighting is applied to represent the spatial distribution of visible evidence around that token. For an attention pair, the two centered views are averaged into a joint distribution, so the attention relation can depend on both relative distance and the surrounding availability pattern.

The distribution is then projected through a cosine basis to produce features. The method injects these features through two paths. Token-level features are added to the token representation. Pair-level features are mapped by a lightweight MLP into angular offsets for RoPE. This keeps the relative-position geometry of RoPE, but makes the rotations responsive to the current mask pattern. The method is different from long-context RoPE adaptations such as LongLLaDA and UltraLLaDA, which mainly target extrapolation beyond the pretraining length; MDLMPE targets the changing availability topology within the current denoising sequence.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover both adaptation and controlled training. On existing MDLM checkpoints, the authors evaluate LLaDA and DREAM at 7B/8B scale with matched post-training on Tulu and SmolTalk. They report improvements on most knowledge, reasoning, and coding evaluations, with broadly similar performance on the remaining tasks. They also run 100M-parameter pretraining and zero-shot evaluation to test whether the signal is useful outside large-checkpoint adaptation.

Additional experiments include block diffusion and component ablations. The useful empirical message is that the identity of [MASK] tokens is not enough. Exposing the spatial distribution of revealed tokens gives the model a cleaner signal about where contextual evidence is available during denoising. The pair-level RoPE-offset path is especially important because it changes the attention geometry rather than only adding another token feature.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus first on the figure contrasting AR contiguous prefixes with MDLM non-contiguous denoising states. Then read the method definitions for binary availability, Gaussian centering, cosine-basis projection, and RoPE angular offsets. In the experiments, prioritize the matched LLaDA/DREAM post-training results and the 100M controlled ablations. For readers working on diffusion LMs, the most useful part to inspect carefully is the pair-feature path that turns mask-state topology into attention-level positional offsets.

recommendation.zh: 直击MDLM的核心痛点（动态非连续上下文的位置编码），做非AR LM的研究者应重点看方法设计部分
recommendation.en: Directly addresses a core pain point of MDLM (positional encoding for dynamic non-contiguous context), read the method section carefully if working on non-autoregressive LMs

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
State Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University

paper.title: Motif-Mamba: network motif improved mamba for long-range sequence modeling
paper.abstract: Efficient long-sequence modeling remains a central challenge for large language models, as self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Mamba offers a linear-time alternative through selective state space recurrence, but its predominantly diagonal state transitions restrict explicit interactions among state dimensions. We propose Motif-Mamba, a structured state space model that augments Mamba with a motif-constrained low-rank recurrent pathway. Inspired by the dynamics of three-node

summary.core_problem: Motif-Mamba 处理的是 Mamba 类 SSM 的一个结构性限制：为了保持线性时间复杂度，状态转移通常接近对角化，不同状态维度之间缺少显式耦合。论文想回答的问题是，能否在不退回到稠密状态转移矩阵的前提下，给 Mamba 加入更强的跨维度动态交互。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的启发主要在架构侧，尤其是长序列 LM 中 SSM 的表达能力问题。贡献量级偏方法增量，不是新的预训练 recipe。值得看的点不是“网络 motif”这个先验本身是否一定成立，而是它把低秩 recurrent coupling 放进选择性 SSM 的方式。这个方向和 Mamba 的核心取舍有关：Mamba 用对角动态换来了并行扫描和线性复杂度，但也牺牲了状态维度间的直接通信。Motif-Mamba 试图用低秩通道补回一部分表达力，计算成本仍控制在可接受范围内。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是在原 Mamba 的选择性 SSM 更新中加入一个低秩 recurrent pathway。具体做法是用两个适配矩阵把高维 hidden state 投影到低维动态子空间，再映射回原状态空间：低秩耦合矩阵可写成 M_I M_J，秩至多为 r，且 r 远小于状态维度 n。这样避免了 n×n 稠密转移矩阵。论文进一步在低维子空间中加入三节点有向网络 motif 的约束，用 motif 的局部连接模式来组织状态维度间的交互。连续时间形式中，低秩项作为额外的 recurrent driving component；离散化使用 exponential Euler 推导，使该项能嵌入 SSM 的逐 token 状态更新。和普通低秩修正相比，它多了 motif-constrained interaction；和标准 Mamba 相比，它不只依赖近似对角的状态演化，而是引入了显式跨维状态通信。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了四类实验：长序列外推、标准语言模型 benchmark、不同 motif 约束的消融，以及脑机接口解码任务。给出的主结论是 Motif-Mamba 相比 Mamba 和若干基线在长程依赖建模上有稳定收益，同时保持线性时间 recurrent 结构。消融部分重点比较不同 motif 动态属性对 hidden-state evolution 的影响，用来支撑 motif 先验不是单纯的参数增加。当前给出的全文材料没有包含具体表格数值、模型规模、rank 设置和 token 规模，因此不宜把性能提升幅度写成定量结论。读这篇时需要特别检查实验表中收益是否来自 motif 结构，还是来自额外低秩参数和更大的有效容量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 15–20 分钟。优先看 Method 中低秩项 M_I M_J 的连续时间定义、exponential Euler 离散化，以及 Appendix B.1 的推导。然后看 motif 约束如何落到低维动态子空间，确认它是 mask、固定拓扑，还是可学习结构。实验部分重点看长序列外推和 ablation：如果去掉 motif 但保留同等 rank 的低秩通道后收益仍接近，motif 解释就要谨慎看待。对 LLM 预训练更关键的问题是扩展性：该结构能否在 billion-scale LM 上保持吞吐、并行扫描兼容性和稳定训练，而不只是中小规模序列任务有效。

summary_en.core_problem: Motif-Mamba targets a specific limitation of Mamba-style SSMs: the transition matrix is usually diagonal or nearly diagonal for efficiency, which weakens explicit interaction across state dimensions. The paper asks whether one can add cross-dimensional recurrent dynamics without paying the cost of a dense state transition.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant as an architecture idea for long-context language modeling. Its contribution is incremental rather than a new pretraining recipe. The useful part is the low-rank recurrent coupling inserted into selective SSM dynamics. Mamba gains linear-time processing by simplifying the state transition, but that simplification reduces direct communication among state channels. Motif-Mamba tries to recover part of this expressivity with a compact recurrent pathway while preserving the main efficiency profile.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method augments the selective SSM update with a low-rank recurrent pathway. Two adapter matrices project the high-dimensional hidden state into a small latent dynamical subspace and map it back. The coupling can be written as M_I M_J, with rank at most r where r is much smaller than the state dimension n. This avoids a dense n-by-n transition matrix. The paper then constrains the interaction pattern in the low-dimensional subspace using directed three-node network motifs. In the continuous-time formulation, the low-rank term acts as an additional recurrent driving component; after exponential Euler discretization, it becomes part of the token-wise SSM update. Compared with standard Mamba, the model adds explicit cross-state communication. Compared with an unconstrained low-rank correction, it imposes a motif-guided structure on the latent dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates the model on long-sequence extrapolation, standard language modeling benchmarks, motif ablations, and brain-computer-interface decoding. The reported conclusion is that Motif-Mamba improves over Mamba and other baselines on long-range dependency modeling while retaining linear recurrent computation. The ablations compare motif choices with different dynamical properties and study their effect on hidden-state evolution. The supplied full-text material does not include concrete table values, parameter counts, rank choices, or data scales, so the gains should not be treated as quantified here. A key check is whether the improvement comes from motif structure itself or mainly from the added low-rank capacity.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–20 minutes. Start with the method section defining the low-rank term M_I M_J and the exponential Euler discretization, then inspect Appendix B.1 for the derivation. Next, check how the motif constraint is implemented in the latent subspace: fixed mask, fixed topology, or learnable structure. In the experiments, prioritize long-sequence extrapolation and the ablation that keeps parameter count or rank controlled. For LLM pretraining, the open question is scalability: whether this coupling remains compatible with high-throughput SSM kernels, stable large-scale optimization, and billion-parameter training.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构图和 LM ablation；motif 叙事未必关键，低秩跨维交互是否真优于常规 mixing 才是重点。
recommendation.en: Skim the architecture and LM ablations; the motif story may be secondary, and the real question is whether low-rank cross-state mixing beats simpler mixing.

paper.title: Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals: Separating Matching and Content Retrieval Across Depth
paper.abstract: Depth-routing residual architectures allow Transformer layers to retrieve earlier representations instead of inheriting only the immediately preceding state. Existing Block Attention Residuals, however, use a single content-dependent depth mixture to construct the inputs to queries, keys, and values. This design couples two functionally different decisions: queries and keys determine where attention matches, whereas values determine what content is retrieved. We therefore ask whether matching an

summary.core_problem: Block Attention Residuals 这类深度路由架构中，每一层用同一个内容相关的深度混合结果作为 Q、K、V 的共同输入。这把注意力的两个功能绑在了一起：Q/K 决定「在哪里匹配」，V 决定「取回什么内容」。论文要验证的是：把 V 的深度路由独立出来，是否能在几乎不增加计算量的前提下提升预训练效果。
summary.importance: 这是对深度路由 Transformer 架构的一个最小化但有明确功能含义的修正。它指出 Block AttnRes 中共享 QKV 深度读取不是无害的实现细节，而是一个有实际影响的约束。对关注 Transformer 残差流设计、深度路由、注意力功能拆分的研究有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals（RD-AttnRes）：Q 和 K 共享一个深度路由混合结果，V 则使用独立的深度路由，两者作用在完全相同的源集合上。MLP 侧的路由、残差源构造、写回方式都保持不变。当 V 的路由查询与 QK 的路由查询绑定时，RD-AttnRes 精确退化为 Block AttnRes，因此是严格的超集扩展。新增参数只有每层一个 d 维的 value route query，参数量增加不到 0.01%。额外计算量是 O(BTKd) 级别的源混合，不增加 O(BT²d) 的 token-to-token 注意力运算。
summary.experiments: 在 FineWeb-Edu 10BT 样本上训练 120M 和 343M 两个规模的模型，各 5 个配对种子，训练 20 亿 token。在所有种子、所有评估里程碑上，RD-AttnRes 的验证 NLL 都低于 Block AttnRes 基线，效果在训练前期更明显，后期绝对值收窄。对照实验表明，单纯增加参数或执行两遍路由并不能复现提升；学到的 QK 路由分布和 V 路由分布确实不相同，支持「匹配几何与内容检索应当解耦」的解释。论文也明确说明没有验证更大规模的缩放行为，也没有和所有深度路由架构做对比。
summary.reading_guide: 重点读第 2 节方法部分的公式推导和退化性证明，理解为什么这是一个严格超集扩展。第 4–5 节的配对实验设计和路由诊断图值得细看，特别是 QK 与 V 路由分布差异的可视化。第 6 节的运行时开销数据也可以快速过一下。预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟。
summary.authors_note: Kimi Team 相关工作（Block AttnRes 原团队延伸）

summary_en.core_problem: In depth-routing architectures like Block Attention Residuals, each layer uses a single content-dependent depth mixture as the shared input to queries, keys, and values. This couples two functionally distinct roles of attention: Q/K determine where attention matches, while V determines what content is retrieved. The paper tests whether giving V its own depth route improves pretraining under a minimal, auditable modification.
summary_en.importance: This is a minimal but functionally meaningful correction to depth-routed Transformer design. It shows that the shared QKV depth read in Block AttnRes is not an innocuous implementation detail but a consequential constraint. The work is directly relevant to research on Transformer residual-stream design, depth routing, and the functional decomposition of attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals (RD-AttnRes) keeps one depth mixture shared between queries and keys, while giving values an independent depth route over exactly the same source set. The MLP-side route, residual source construction, and writeback all remain unchanged. When the value route query is tied to the QK route query, RD-AttnRes exactly recovers Block AttnRes — making it a strict superset extension. The only new parameters are one d-dimensional value route query per layer, adding less than 0.01% parameters. The extra computation is O(BTKd) for the second source mixture, with no additional O(BT²d) token-to-token attention cost.
summary_en.experiments: Models of 120M and 343M parameters are trained on the FineWeb-Edu 10BT sample for 2.0B tokens, with 5 paired seeds each. RD-AttnRes achieves lower validation NLL than Block AttnRes on every seed and at every evaluation milestone; the effect is larger early in training and narrows in absolute magnitude later. Controls show that simply adding parameters or running two routes does not reproduce the gain, and the learned QK and V route distributions do not collapse to the same solution — consistent with the proposed decoupling explanation. The paper explicitly does not claim universal scaling behavior or superiority to all depth-routing architectures.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the method derivation and the exact-recovery argument showing RD-AttnRes is a strict superset. Sections 4–5 contain the paired experimental design and route diagnostics; the visualization of diverging QK vs V distributions is particularly worth examining. Section 6 on runtime overhead can be skimmed. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Extension of the Kimi Team Block AttnRes work

recommendation.zh: 这是那种值得架构组做一轮小型 ablation 的 paper：想法干净、改动便宜，但先别改 prior，得看它是否只在特定 depth-routing setup 下成立。
recommendation.en: This is the kind of paper worth a small internal ablation: the idea is clean and cheap, but don’t update your prior until you see whether it only works in a narrow depth-routing setup.

paper.title: Mamba with Hierarchical Memory: Solving Representation Bottleneck in Long Sequence Modeling
paper.abstract: Recurrent linear attention models (RLAs) such as Mamba offer efficient linear-time sequence modeling as an alternative to Transformers, yet their fixed-capacity recurrent states limit long-sequence modeling. Drawing inspiration from hierarchical human memory, we propose Hierarchical Memory Mamba (HMM) to address this limitation. Building upon a pre-trained Mamba backbone, HMM integrates a lightweight working memory that extracts slow paragraph-level semantics (PLS) from the fast sensory memory e

summary.core_problem: Mamba 等循环线性注意力模型用固定容量的循环状态压缩历史，长序列建模时存在表示瓶颈。
summary.importance: 针对 RLA 长上下文能力的架构改进，思路是把多时间尺度记忆引入预训练 Mamba；但更像插件式增强，尚未构成新范式。
summary.technical_approach: 在预训练 Mamba 主干上加入轻量工作记忆，从主干隐藏状态中提取段落级慢语义，再压缩为持久化长期记忆并按任务检索；层次化语义处理通过参数化学习实现跨任务泛化。
summary.experiments: 在 Passkey Retrieval 和 LongBench-E 上评测，检索成功率提升 34.3–37.1%；摘要截断，未给出完整基线和模型规模。

summary_en.core_problem: Recurrent linear attention models such as Mamba compress history into a fixed-capacity recurrent state, creating a representation bottleneck for long-sequence modeling.
summary_en.importance: An architectural enhancement for long-context RLAs that introduces multi-timescale memory into a pretrained Mamba backbone; promising but still reads as a plug-in extension rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: HMM adds a lightweight working memory on top of a pretrained Mamba backbone, extracts slow paragraph-level semantics from fast hidden states, compresses them into persistent long-term memory, and retrieves task-relevant memory parametrically.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Passkey Retrieval and LongBench-E, reporting 34.3–37.1% retrieval-success improvements; the abstract is truncated and omits full baselines and model sizes.

recommendation.zh: 在预训练 Mamba 上加层次记忆，思路直观但更像长上下文插件；只看架构图和 LongBench-E 表格，暂不改变架构选型。
recommendation.en: A hierarchical memory plug-in for pretrained Mamba; intuitive but incremental. Inspect the architecture diagram and LongBench-E table, not enough to shift model selection.

paper.title: Looped Transformers with Source-Centered State Evolution
paper.abstract: Looped Transformers create a useful train- and test-time compute axis by reusing the same Transformer block over recurrent depth, increasing effective depth at a fixed parameter count. However, that shared block must then govern an entire trajectory of varying hidden states over trained and extrapolated depths. Furthermore, in additive-injection looped Transformers, an input-conditioned signal is reintroduced at every recurrent step, so applying the shared transition at an input-conditioned refe

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理 looped Transformer 的一个具体稳定性问题：同一个 Transformer block 被反复复用时，输入相关的 source 如果在每一步都以加法方式重新注入，会让某个输入条件下的参考状态不再是固定点。即使隐藏状态已经到达作者定义的 anchor，下一次共享转移仍可能产生更新。这个“zero-deviation forcing bias”会沿循环深度传播，在训练深度内可能被模型利用，但在测试时增加循环次数后容易变成不可控的动态。论文的目标是让共享递归既保留输入条件信息，又避免 anchor 位置被重复 source 注入推着走。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构和训练动态层面。Looped Transformer 把深度变成一种可复用的 train/test-time compute 轴，参数量不变但有效深度可变。这和 latent reasoning、adaptive compute、长程算法泛化都有关系。贡献不在于给出一个通用的新 LM scaling recipe，而是把循环深度外推中的一个隐含自由度形式化，并用结构约束消掉。它提示了一点：当参数共享跨越深度时，常规 Transformer 中无害的 residual/source injection 会变成递归系统里的 forcing term，需要按动力系统的固定点和轨迹稳定性来设计。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 Source-Centered State Evolution，简称 SCSE。作者先从输入表示 e 计算一个 learned anchor h*(e)，然后不直接在绝对 hidden state 上做循环更新，而是在相对坐标 Δ_t = h_t - h*(e) 上演化。模型实际的一步转移写成 T_t(Δ; e)，在 Δ=0 时的输出 b_t(e)=T_t(0;e) 被定义为 zero-deviation forcing bias。普通 additive-injection looped Transformer 没有约束 b_t(e)，所以 anchor 处仍可能产生 source-driven update。SCSE 则让递归 core 对零偏移保持零映射，并用 mask 使 zero-deviation 的边界精确成立，从结构上保证 T_t(0;e)=0。输入依赖没有被拿掉，而是分离到 anchor 和初始 deviation 中；真正的循环计算只在非零 deviation 上发生。和简单调参、增加容量、给 recurrent step 加条件不同，SCSE 改的是递归坐标系和固定点约束，目标是让共享 block 在训练深度和外推深度都面对一致的状态语义。
summary.experiments: 主实验在 WikiText-103 上比较 SCSE、基础 looped Transformer，以及若干控制组，包括 tuned baseline、capacity-matched control 和 recurrent-step-conditioned control。论文报告 SCSE 在所有评估循环深度上都取得最低 shared-block perplexity，覆盖训练 loop-depth 范围内和范围外。这个结果的重点不是单一深度上的 PPL，而是曲线形态：SCSE 在增加循环次数时更稳定，说明固定点约束降低了 depth extrapolation 时的动态漂移。文中还通过 anchor-response 诊断和 appendix 的 bias-subtraction counterfactual，把性能差异和 zero-deviation forcing bias 联系起来。给定材料中没有完整表格数字，因此不宜复述具体 PPL；建议以 Figure 3 和 Table 1 的深度-PPL 曲线为准。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 source、anchor、zero-deviation forcing bias 的定义，这是全文最有信息量的部分。然后看方法部分 SCSE 如何构造 anchor、deviation、zero-preserving core 和 mask。实验部分重点看 Figure 3 和 Table 1，关注不同 loop depth 下 PPL 曲线是否平滑，以及训练深度外推时各 baseline 如何退化。appendix 的 bias-subtraction counterfactual 值得快速扫一遍，它能帮助判断 SCSE 的收益是否来自固定点约束，而不只是容量或正则化差异。若关注预训练架构，可重点思考这个设计能否迁移到 MoE recurrent block、latent reasoning block 或 test-time compute 可调的解码前隐空间迭代。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific dynamical issue in looped Transformers. When the same Transformer block is reused across recurrent depth, additive reinjection of an input-conditioned source can make an input-conditioned reference state fail to be a fixed point. Even if the hidden state is exactly at the chosen anchor, another application of the shared transition may still produce an update. The authors call this the zero-deviation forcing bias. It can be harmless or useful within the trained loop-depth range, but it becomes a source of uncontrolled dynamics when depth is extrapolated at test time.
summary_en.importance: The relevance is architectural and dynamical rather than data-centric. Looped Transformers expose depth as a reusable compute axis: effective depth can grow without adding a separate parameter set for every layer. That connects to adaptive compute, latent reasoning, and algorithmic generalization. The useful contribution is the formulation of a hidden degree of freedom that ordinary residual/source injection creates under parameter sharing. In non-shared Transformers, different layers can absorb such effects locally. In a recurrently shared block, the same effect becomes a repeated forcing term, so fixed-point behavior and trajectory consistency matter.
summary_en.technical_approach: Source-Centered State Evolution, or SCSE, reparameterizes the recurrent computation around a learned input-conditioned anchor h*(e). Instead of evolving the absolute hidden state directly, it evolves the deviation Δ_t = h_t - h*(e). The one-step map in these coordinates is T_t(Δ; e), and its value at zero deviation, b_t(e)=T_t(0;e), measures the forcing bias at the anchor. Standard additive looped Transformers do not constrain this quantity. SCSE constructs a zero-preserving recurrent core and uses a mask so that the zero-deviation boundary is exact, giving T_t(0;e)=0 by construction. Input dependence is retained through the anchor and the initial deviation; recurrent computation is driven by off-anchor state. This differs from adding capacity, tuning the baseline, or conditioning on the recurrent step, because it changes the coordinate system and enforces a reference-preserving transition.
summary_en.experiments: The main comparison is on WikiText-103. SCSE is evaluated against a baseline looped Transformer and several controls, including tuned, capacity-matched, and recurrent-step-conditioned variants. The reported result is that SCSE obtains the lowest shared-block perplexity at every evaluated loop depth, both within and beyond the trained loop-depth range. The important experimental signal is the depth-PPL curve rather than a single number: SCSE maintains better behavior as recurrent passes increase. The paper also uses an anchor-response diagnostic and an appendix counterfactual based on bias subtraction to connect the gains to control of the zero-deviation forcing bias. Exact PPL values are not available in the provided text, so Figure 3 and Table 1 should be treated as the source of record.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction’s definitions of source, anchor, deviation, and zero-deviation forcing bias. Then read the SCSE method to see how the anchor, deviation dynamics, zero-preserving core, and mask are implemented. In the experiments, focus on Figure 3 and Table 1, especially how perplexity changes as loop depth moves outside the trained range. The appendix counterfactual is worth scanning because it helps separate the effect of fixed-point control from ordinary tuning or capacity effects. For pretraining architecture work, the main question is whether the same source-centered design applies to recurrent MoE blocks, latent reasoning modules, or other test-time-compute mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: Looped Transformer状态漂移问题的扎实改进，有明确不变性保证，做test-time scaling架构的看§3方法设计即可。
recommendation.en: A solid fix for state drift in looped Transformers with clear invariance guarantees; read §3 for the design if you work on test-time compute architectures.

paper.title: Metis: Memory Foundation Model
paper.abstract: Recent advances in AI agents have increasingly internalized native capabilities into their underlying foundation models, giving rise to multimodal foundation models and large reasoning models. However, agent memory is still primarily implemented through external modules, leaving the native memory capability largely unexplored. In this paper, we take a first step toward this direction by introducing memory foundation models, which empower foundation models with native memory capabilities. We form

summary.core_problem: 把“agent 记忆”从外置 RAG/数据库模块，变成可端到端训练、在多轮推理间保持状态的“原生（native）记忆能力”：模型内部要有可持续演化的记忆状态，并且在一次 forward 里能自主执行写入/更新/遗忘等记忆过程。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于：它把“记忆”重新表述为一种可通过 mid-training 学到的建模能力，而不是工程外挂；并给出一套可训练的目标函数（重建 + 操作监督 + 正则）和合成数据管线。启发点主要在 pretrain↔posttrain 接口：如果记忆状态是可微、可优化的动态参数，那么领域适配、持续学习、以及 RL/对齐信号就有机会直接作用在记忆机制上，而不是只作用在 prompt/RAG 策略上。论文更像原型与框架，离大规模通用落地还有距离。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 概念定义：
- Native Memory State：模型跨多次推理保持“有状态”，记忆以 backbone 内部的动态参数/状态形式存在，并要求其语义空间在预训练或 mid-training 阶段对齐。
- Native Memory Procedure：记忆操作（记住/忘记/更新/利用）不通过外部检索与拼 prompt，而是作为模型计算图的一部分在 forward 中完成。

2) 架构实现（Metis 原型）：
- 以 Fast Weight Programming 思路做“可快速更新的权重/状态”。论文描述为 Metis block，由 hyper memory block + local memory block 组成，并通过 memory attention 将记忆状态注入到 backbone 计算。
- 直觉上：local 更像短期/局部上下文的可写状态；hyper 更像控制写入与读取的上层机制（类似超网络/门控），用来稳定训练并让记忆更新可控。

3) 训练目标（让记忆既能压缩存储，又能学会操作）：
- Memory reconstruction objective：约束记忆状态对过去信息的“可恢复性/压缩上限”，相当于让状态确实承载信息而不是漂移成噪声。
- Memory operation objectives：对写入/更新/遗忘/调用等过程给监督或自监督信号，定义“该怎么改状态”。这部分决定记忆过程是否可用，而不仅是状态里有信息。
- Regularization objective：用于复杂场景鲁棒性，避免记忆被污染、灾难性覆盖或不受控累积。

4) 数据：用公开数据合成“memory-specific”训练样本做 mid-training，让模型在受控任务上学会跨轮存取与更新。论文把记忆视作预测问题：存储阶段不知道未来怎么用，推理阶段只能用存下来的摘要，因此训练应逼迫模型学会“为未来用途做有损压缩”。
summary.experiments: 给出的全文片段未包含可核验的具体实验表格与数字（模型规模、数据量、各任务提升幅度、消融结果等），因此无法在不臆测的前提下复述关键数值。就论文宣称的实验范围而言：他们做了“广泛实验”来验证框架有效性，并分析 native memory 的多方面性质（例如端到端优化、推理时延、鲁棒性等）。建议以论文中的主表（与外置记忆/RAG/无记忆 backbone 的对比）和消融（去掉 reconstruction / operation / regularization、替换 memory attention 形式、不同记忆容量/更新频率）为核心来判断贡献是否扎实。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 对 external memory 三个痛点的拆解：目标解耦、不可端到端、在线时延。
- 重点看“Metis block”结构图与 memory attention 的公式/伪代码：它决定这是不是“可训练的动态参数”，还是换皮的长上下文。
- 再看训练目标三件套（reconstruction / operation / regularization）：分别解决“存得下”“会用”“不崩”。
- 最后扫实验部分的两类证据：1) 与 RAG/外置记忆的对比是否在同等算力与延迟下公平；2) 消融是否证明性能来自记忆机制而不是数据合成或额外训练步数。
如果要深挖：重点追问记忆状态的容量、更新规则是否会导致训练不稳定（loss spike/梯度爆炸）、以及跨任务迁移时记忆是否会产生负迁移或污染。

summary_en.core_problem: Turning agent memory from an external RAG/database module into a native, differentiable capability: the model should maintain a persistent, evolving internal memory state across sessions and autonomously perform write/update/forget/read operations within the forward pass.
summary_en.importance: The main pretraining-facing value is the reframing of “memory” as a trainable modeling capability (via mid-training) rather than an engineering add-on. The paper proposes a concrete recipe—architecture + objectives + synthetic data—to make memory end-to-end optimizable. This is most relevant to the pretrain↔posttrain interface: if memory is a differentiable internal state, domain adaptation, continual pretraining, and even alignment/RL signals could directly shape memory behaviors instead of only shaping prompting or retrieval policies. It reads more like an early prototype/framework than a fully validated large-scale solution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Definitions:
- Native Memory State: a stateful backbone whose internal dynamic parameters/state persist across multiple inferences; the state’s semantic space is aligned during pretraining or mid-training.
- Native Memory Procedure: memory operations (store/forget/update/use) are executed as part of the model computation, not via external retrieval and prompt concatenation.

2) Architecture (Metis prototype):
- Inspired by Fast Weight Programming: introduce fast-changing weights/states integrated into the backbone.
- A Metis block contains a hyper memory block and a local memory block, and injects memory via a dedicated memory-attention mechanism.
- Intuition: local memory acts like writable short-term state; hyper memory controls/stabilizes how state is written/read (akin to gating or a hypernetwork-style controller).

3) Training objectives (making memory both information-bearing and operational):
- Memory reconstruction objective: enforces that the memory state actually compresses and retains past information (an upper bound on what can be stored/recovered).
- Memory operation objectives: supervise or self-supervise the desired state transitions for write/update/forget/read, so the model learns procedures, not just storage.
- Regularization objective: improves robustness under complex scenarios, mitigating drift, contamination, or uncontrolled accumulation.

4) Data: large-scale synthetic “memory-specific” mid-training data derived from public datasets. The paper frames memory as a prediction problem under streaming constraints: you store without knowing future use, and later you can only act on what was stored, so training should force purposeful lossy compression for future utility.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include verifiable quantitative results (model sizes, data scale, main-table numbers, ablations). Without those, it’s not safe to quote metrics. The paper claims extensive experiments demonstrating effectiveness and analyses of native memory properties (end-to-end optimization, latency, robustness). When reading, the key is whether (i) comparisons against external-memory baselines are latency/compute-matched, and (ii) ablations isolate gains from the memory mechanism rather than extra mid-training or synthetic data artifacts.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the Introduction’s critique of external memory: objective decoupling, lack of differentiability, and inference latency.
- Focus on the Metis block diagram and the memory-attention equations/pseudocode: this determines whether the approach is truly “native state as dynamic parameters”.
- Then read the three-objective training recipe (reconstruction/operation/regularization) as the core technical contribution.
- Finally, scan experiments for two pieces of evidence: fair baselines under comparable latency/compute, and ablations that attribute gains to memory state/procedures.
For deeper digging: check memory capacity vs. stability (loss spikes/gradients), and whether memory causes negative transfer or contamination across tasks/domains.

recommendation.zh: 不是成熟结论，更像把“外部记忆”往 backbone 里推的一次原型试探；重点看 memory state 的定义和更新式，若写得干净，值得内部做小规模复现。
recommendation.en: Not a settled result but a serious prototype pushing memory from external modules into the backbone; read it for the memory-state definition and update rule, then decide if it merits a small internal reproduction.

paper.title: Raven: High-Recall Sequence Modeling with Sparse Memory Routing
paper.abstract: Long-context recall in linear-time sequence models highlights a tradeoff in how they write to memory. State-based linear models, such as state-space models (SSMs) and linear Transformers, write densely, updating the entire state for each newly arrived token, which leads to interference and makes specific past tokens hard to recover. Sliding-window attention (SWA) exhibits the opposite behavior: it writes sparsely by storing explicit token representations, but only within a fixed window, so recal

summary.core_problem: 线性时间序列模型（包括状态空间模型SSM、线性Transformer、滑动窗口注意力SWA）在长上下文记忆上存在根本性的写记忆权衡：SSM类模型每步对全状态做稠密写入，不同token的信息相互干扰，难以精准召回久远的特定token；SWA类模型做稀疏写入，但只保留固定窗口内的显式token表示，一旦内容滑出窗口就会完全丢失。现有线性模型的设计始终停留在这两个极端，缺少介于“稠密写入全局记忆”和“稀疏写入固定窗口”之间的中间方案，导致长距离召回能力薄弱，上下文长度外推性能差。
summary.importance: 该工作将现有线性时序模型的记忆机制统一到“路由写入+选择性衰减”的框架下，明确指出SSM和SWA是该框架上的两个极端端点。提出的Raven结构在保持线性推理复杂度的同时大幅提升长序列召回能力，不需要叠加卷积或SWA辅助层就能实现可靠的长距离记忆，对下一代非Transformer线性架构的长上下文设计有直接参考价值，也明确了全状态稠密更新带来的写入干扰是现有SSM类模型长上下文召回差的核心原因。
summary.technical_approach: 该工作首先提出路由槽记忆（Routing Slot Memories, RSM）的统一框架，将固定大小记忆矩阵的更新拆解为两个独立维度：一是写入路由，决定新内容写入哪些记忆槽；二是槽位衰减，只对被写入的槽位应用遗忘衰减，未被选中的槽位内容完全保留，不被覆盖或衰减。在这一框架下，SSM对应每步全槽位稠密写入+全局逐步衰减的极端，SWA对应确定性轮流写入单一槽位+硬驱逐（未写入槽位保留内容直到被轮转到覆盖）的另一个极端。Raven作为RSM的具体实现：每步通过输入依赖的可学习路由选择少量记忆槽（稀疏路由，既非全槽写入也非固定轮转单个槽位），仅对选中的槽位写入新的内容，并仅对这些槽位应用可学习的衰减；未选中的槽位完全保留原有信息，不做任何更新或衰减。Raven块不需要叠加卷积层或滑动窗口注意力辅助，单一RSM层就能同时实现记忆持久化和精准召回，保持严格的线性时间复杂度。
summary.experiments: 实验对比Mamba-2、Gated DeltaNet（GDN）、Gated Linear Attention（GLA）、SWA等主流线性序列模型：一是Needle-in-a-Haystack测试中，SWA在窗口外的召回率接近0，Raven在超出训练长度16倍的外推设置下仍能实现完美召回；二是标准语言建模任务上，Raven的困惑度与Mamba-2、GDN、GLA等近年提出的线性模型持平或更优；三是召回密集型任务上，无论是独立使用Raven结构还是与注意力机制混合，性能都显著优于SWA和SSM基线，结果在不同模型规模下保持一致；四是消融实验验证了稀疏路由和选择性衰减两个设计的独立贡献：仅保留稀疏路由但对所有槽位应用全局衰减，会损失长期记忆保持能力；仅保留选择性衰减但对所有槽位做稠密写入，则退化为类似GLA的稠密更新模型，召回性能大幅下降。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3节RSM统一框架的推导部分，尤其是将SSM和SWA都归约到同一更新公式下的内容（对应原论文公式1到公式5的对比）。这部分是整个工作的核心概念贡献，厘清了此前线性模型记忆设计中未被明确讨论的隐含权衡。之后看第4节Raven的路由机制和衰减设计的具体实现，留意路由稀疏度、衰减作用范围的设计选择。实验部分重点关注长度外推下的Needle测试结果和消融实验，理解两个设计维度各自的独立贡献。值得深挖的方向包括：路由稀疏度随模型规模、训练长度的scaling规律，路由决策的可解释性（不同槽位是否对应不同类型的记忆内容），以及RSM框架下更灵活的记忆管理策略（如动态槽位数量、显式记忆擦除）。

summary_en.core_problem: Linear-time sequence models (state space models/SSMs, linear Transformers, sliding-window attention/SWA) face a fundamental write-memory tradeoff for long-context recall: dense-write models like SSMs update their entire state at every step, causing cross-token interference that makes precise retrieval of old, specific tokens difficult; sparse-write models like SWA store explicit token representations but only within a fixed recent window, leading to total information loss once tokens are evicted. Existing linear architectures leave this tradeoff implicit, with no intermediate design point between dense global memory and sparse fixed-window memory, resulting in weak long-range recall and poor length extrapolation.
summary_en.importance: This work unifies the memory mechanisms of existing linear sequence models under a single “routing + selective decay” framework, explicitly identifying SSMs and SWA as two extreme points on the routing spectrum. The proposed Raven architecture delivers substantially improved long-sequence recall while retaining linear time complexity, and achieves reliable long-range retrieval without relying on auxiliary convolution or SWA layers. It provides a concrete design direction for long-context non-Transformer linear architectures, and identifies dense full-state updates as the root cause of poor long-context recall in prior SSM variants.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work first proposes Routing Slot Memories (RSM), a unifying framework that decomposes fixed-size memory updates into two independent dimensions: (1) write routing, which selects a subset of memory slots to write new content to; (2) slot-wise decay, which applies forgetting operators only to slots that receive new writes, leaving unselected slots completely untouched with no overwrites or decay. Under this framework, SSMs correspond to the extreme of dense full-slot writes with global gradual decay, while SWA corresponds to the extreme of deterministic round-robin single-slot writes with hard eviction (unselected slots retain content until overwritten on their rotation). Raven is a concrete RSM instantiation that uses learned, input-dependent sparse routing to select a small subset of slots per step—neither writing to all slots nor rotating deterministically through a single slot. New content is only written to selected slots, and learnable decay is applied exclusively to these updated slots, while unselected slots retain their content indefinitely without any update or decay. The Raven block requires no auxiliary convolution or sliding-window attention layers; a single RSM layer supports both persistent memory and precise recall while maintaining strict linear time complexity.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated against strong linear model baselines including Mamba-2, Gated DeltaNet (GDN), Gated Linear Attention (GLA), and SWA: (1) On Needle-in-a-Haystack benchmarks, SWA achieves near-zero recall for tokens outside its fixed window, while Raven maintains perfect recall even when extrapolating to 16x the training context length; (2) On standard language modeling, Raven matches or outperforms recent linear model variants including Mamba-2, GDN, and GLA in perplexity; (3) On recall-heavy tasks, Raven delivers substantial improvements over SWA and SSM baselines in both standalone and hybrid-with-attention configurations, with consistent results across model scales; (4) Ablations confirm independent contributions of the two core design choices: sparse routing alone with global full-state decay reduces long-term memory retention, while selective decay alone with dense full-slot writes degenerates to GLA-like behavior with significantly degraded recall.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3, which develops the unifying RSM framework, particularly the derivation that maps both SSM and SWA update rules to the same general recurrence (Equations 1 through 5). This conceptual unification is the core insight of the work, making explicit the previously implicit tradeoff in linear model memory design. Next, study the specific routing and decay implementation in Section 4, paying close attention to design choices around routing sparsity and decay scope. In experiments, focus on the length-extrapolation Needle-in-a-Haystack results and ablation studies to isolate the contribution of each design component. Open directions worth exploring include scaling behavior of routing sparsity with model size and training context length, interpretability of routing decisions (whether slots specialize to specific memory types), and more flexible memory management policies under the RSM framework (e.g., dynamic slot counts, explicit memory erasure).

recommendation.zh: 把 SSM 与 SWA 的记忆写入机制做了干净的插值，应立刻在内部长程 recall ablation 中复现，看路由稀疏度的 scaling。
recommendation.en: A clean interpolation between SSM and SWA memory writes; reproduce it in internal long-context recall ablations and watch how routed sparsity scales.

paper.title: cMoLLM at Scale: Horizontal Scaling Laws for Mixture-of-LLMs
paper.abstract: Scaling large language models (LLMs) has driven their success, yet dense Transformers couple capacity and computation: every parameter is activated for every token, making training and inference costs grow linearly with model size-a critical bottleneck as models approach trillion-parameter regimes. We aim to scale capacity through MoE-style mixture throughout the LLM pipeline rather than only the FFN. Prior pipeline-level approaches include ParaScale, which introduces virtual tokens and parallel

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文试图解决 dense Transformer 中容量和计算强绑定的问题：参数越多，每个 token 激活的参数也越多。作者希望把 MoE 的条件计算从 FFN 层扩展到整个 LLM pipeline，同时避免已有 pipeline-level mixture 方法中的虚拟 token 开销、路由同质化和训练不稳定。
summary.importance: 这是一篇架构与扩展方法论文，对预训练研究的价值在于提出了一种“横向扩容”的实现路径。它不只是把 FFN 换成专家，而是把完整 stream / sub-model 作为混合对象，并用动态卷积视角统一解释 MoE-style mixture。贡献量级目前更接近可跟进的架构探索：实验基于 GPT-2 风格模型和 FineWeb，能说明训练可行性与趋势，但还不能直接证明在大规模预训练下优于成熟 MoE 路线。
summary.technical_approach: 核心理论点是把 MoE-style mixture 等价改写为输入相关的 dynamic convolution：每个 expert 可看成一个 1×1 convolution kernel，router 产生输入相关的 kernel mixing 权重。基于这个视角，作者提出 cMoLLM。模型维护多个端到端 stream，每个 stream 对应独立的 1×1 kernel；轻量 gating network 为输入生成 soft mixture weights；最终通过 grouped pointwise convolution 完成混合。与 Top-K MoE 不同，它使用连续可微的 soft gating，不做离散路由；与 ParaScale 不同，它不引入虚拟 token，避免增加序列长度；与 AltUp 不同，它不依赖辅助预测分支，适应性更强。
summary.experiments: 实验在 GPT-2 风格模型上进行，预训练数据使用 FineWeb，并在 perplexity、GLUE、SQuAD 等指标上比较 dense baseline、ParaScale-style 方法和 AltUp-style 方法。论文报告 cMoLLM 在相近成本下匹配或优于 dense baseline，并表现出更好的 stream utilization、更稳定的训练动态和更好的 scaling 趋势。给定材料没有提供具体参数规模、训练 token 数、困惑度数值或任务提升幅度；这些需要重点查 Section 5.3 和附录实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–40 分钟。先看 Theorem 4.1，确认 MoE 与 dynamic convolution 的等价关系是否只是形式重写，还是能约束实际设计。然后看 cMoLLM 的 stream、gating、grouped pointwise convolution 细节，重点关注计算图是否真的保持硬件友好。实验部分优先看 Section 5.3 的 scaling 曲线、训练稳定性、stream utilization，以及与 ParaScale / AltUp 的公平成本对齐。若资源有限，可跳过一般 MoE 背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the tight coupling between capacity and compute in dense Transformers: increasing parameters also increases the number of parameters activated for every token. It aims to extend conditional computation from FFN-only MoE layers to the whole LLM pipeline, while avoiding the overhead and instability seen in prior pipeline-level mixture methods.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining research is architectural. The paper proposes a horizontal capacity-scaling mechanism where entire streams or sub-model pipelines are mixed, rather than only replacing FFNs with experts. Its current impact should be read as an architecture exploration with useful design signals. The experiments are on GPT-2-style models trained on FineWeb, so they support feasibility and scaling trends, but do not yet settle whether this approach beats mature large-scale MoE training recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central idea is a formal equivalence between MoE-style mixture layers and dynamic convolutions with input-dependent kernels. Each expert can be interpreted as a 1×1 convolutional kernel, and the router produces input-dependent weights for mixing those kernels. Based on this view, the authors introduce cMoLLM. The model keeps multiple end-to-end streams, associates each stream with a distinct 1×1 kernel, uses a lightweight gating network to produce soft mixture weights, and implements the final mixing through grouped pointwise convolution. Unlike Top-K MoE, it uses fully differentiable soft gating. Unlike ParaScale, it does not add virtual tokens and therefore avoids increasing sequence length. Unlike AltUp, it does not rely on an auxiliary prediction branch.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study uses GPT-2-style models trained on FineWeb, with evaluations on perplexity, GLUE, and SQuAD. The paper reports that cMoLLM matches or improves over dense baselines under comparable cost, and shows better stream utilization, more stable training dynamics, and favorable scaling compared with ParaScale-style and AltUp-style pipeline mixtures. The provided text does not include exact parameter counts, training-token budgets, perplexity values, or task-level gains; these should be checked in Section 5.3 and the appendix tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Start with Theorem 4.1 to judge whether the MoE-to-dynamic-convolution equivalence provides design constraints or is mainly a useful reformulation. Then read the cMoLLM architecture details: streams, gating, and grouped pointwise convolution. In the experiments, focus on Section 5.3, especially scaling curves, training stability, stream utilization, and cost matching against ParaScale and AltUp. The general MoE background can be skipped if already familiar.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它把 MoE 解释成动态卷积这一步；若实验做得干净，这会改变你对“专家只该放 FFN” 的先验，但先别急着信 headline，先查路由熵和 collapse 分析。
recommendation.en: The interesting part is the MoE-as-dynamic-convolution reframing; if the experiments are clean, it weakens the prior that experts belong only in FFNs, but verify routing entropy and collapse diagnostics before buying the scaling claim.

paper.title: Hierarchical Grading in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: We introduce Graded Large Language Models (GLLMs), an algebraic framework that equips the representation space of a transformer with a grading and propagates the induced weighted scalar action through embeddings, self-attention, and the training objective. The construction extends the theory of graded neural networks and graded transformers to autoregressive language models while preserving expressive power, asymptotic computational complexity, and inference cost.   The governing geometric pictu

summary.core_problem: 提出一种给 Transformer 表示空间加入代数 grading 的语言模型框架，试图刻画不同表示维度或子空间的非均匀权重结构。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏理论架构分析。它试图用几何不变量理论解释何时非均匀 grading 能优于普通均匀 Transformer，同时声称不增加渐近复杂度和推理成本；但摘要没有显示实证验证，可信度主要取决于形式化假设。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Graded Large Language Models，将 grading 诱导的加权标量作用传播到 embedding、self-attention 和训练目标中。论文使用 Kempf--Ness functional、Hilbert--Mumford 型判据和 moment map 来描述可改进普通架构的 grade cone，并给出闭式最优 grade。
summary.experiments: 摘要未报告模型参数量、训练语料、benchmark、baseline 或实验结果。当前信息显示这是一篇形式化理论论文，而非经验架构论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes an algebraic grading framework for transformer representation spaces in autoregressive language models.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a theoretical architecture contribution. It claims that non-uniform grading can improve over a uniform transformer without changing asymptotic complexity or inference cost, but the abstract provides no empirical validation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Graded Large Language Models propagate a weighted scalar action induced by grading through embeddings, self-attention, and the training objective. The analysis uses Kempf–Ness functionals, Hilbert–Mumford-style criteria, and moment maps to characterize beneficial grade directions.
summary_en.experiments: No model size, training data, benchmark, baseline, or numerical result is provided in the abstract. The work appears to be formal and theoretical rather than empirical.

recommendation.zh: 作为理论备查即可；没有实验前不要改架构 prior，最多看它如何形式化“非均匀通道权重”。
recommendation.en: Keep it as theory reference; without experiments it should not move architecture priors, except for its formalization of non-uniform channel weighting.

paper.title: When Does Recurrence Become an Algorithm? Convergence Selection in Weight-Tied Looped Transformers
paper.abstract: When does a weight-tied looped transformer -- one block applied T times -- implement an actual algorithm? We answer with four findings from controlled populations on group word problems. (1) The budget law: free training installs a linear computation frontier, a mechanism that solves v positions per loop, whose speed is priced by the training contract: v ~ n_train/T_train (exponent 0.98 +/- 0.04, R^2=0.99), exactly unity under T=n training. SGD selects a frontier matching the minimum the contrac

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究一个很具体但重要的问题：weight-tied looped Transformer 重复应用同一个 block 多次时，它学到的是可随 test-time loops 扩展的迭代算法，还是只是在若干步内完成计算后进入固定点。更精确地说，作者想区分三类机制：常数步 shortcut、对数深度 parallel scan、线性步 serial computation，并解释 SGD 在不同训练合约下会选择哪一种。
summary.importance: 这篇值得精读。它把“递归 Transformer 是否学到算法”从直觉问题变成可测量的问题，并指出常用诊断工具会被收敛态误导。对预训练研究有三点启发。第一，test-time compute 不是只靠增加 loop 数就自然获得，训练合约会决定模型内部计算前沿的速度。第二，weight tying 不只是参数共享，它改变了优化偏置，使模型从标准深度 Transformer 倾向的 parallel scan 转向 serial frontier。第三，机制可迁移性可以通过 budget annealing 获得，这对 adaptive compute、looped model、latent reasoning 训练 recipe 都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 模型是 depth-recurrent Transformer：同一个 Transformer block Fθ 被重复应用 T 次，状态更新为 h^{t+1}=Fθ(h^t,e)，其中 token embedding e 可以在每一轮通过 learned adapter 重新注入。主实验使用 NoPE，附录中控制位置编码影响。作者强调，跳过最后几轮是否影响输出、不同 loop 的 Jacobian 是否相似，这些 tail instruments 不足以判断算法性。原因是：一旦轨迹接近固定点，跳过一步通常不会改变结果，相邻步骤的局部线性化也会自然相似。为解决这个问题，他们提出 head instrument：convergence-time scaling τ(n,i)。τ(n,i) 定义为长度 n 的输入中，第 i 个位置的 decoded output 第一次达到最终值并保持不变所需的 loop 数。τ 的增长类型就是机制签名：常数表示 shortcut 或 refinement，log n 表示 parallel scan，线性 n 表示 serial step-indexed computation。作者还用 streaming positive control 校准该指标：当 token i 只能在第 i 轮被揭示时，τ 读出线性斜率 1.0；shortcut 控制组则保持平坦。
summary.experiments: 实验是受控 population study，而不是单次训练曲线。模型规模包括 s：2 层 block、d=128；m：2 层 block、d=256；l：4 层 block、d=512。任务包括 prefix parity、低位优先 increment-with-carry，以及一组 group word problems：Z60、S4、S5、A5。这些任务有清楚的理论结构：Z60 和 S4 存在常数深度 shortcut；S5 和 A5 word problem 与 NC1-complete 相关；关联 scan 原理上用 Θ(log n) loop depth 可解。主要结果有几组。第一，free training 学到的是线性 computation frontier：每个 loop 解决 v 个位置，速度满足 v≈n_tr/T_tr；当训练合约是 T=n 时，速度约为 1。第二，在固定输入长度下，测试时给比训练更多的 loops 可以补救靠后位置，说明模型确实形成了按位置推进的计算前沿。第三，标准 tail 指标失效：在有足够 solved examples 的模型上，single-step skip retention 接近完全保留，cross-step Jacobian alignment 普遍很高，但这些指标与长度泛化不相关。第四，学习困难不是简单由电路复杂度决定：A5 这类 NC1-hard 任务并不形成主要障碍，S5 的 operator scale 更难；operator-first curriculum 可以消除这个 wall。第五，强行施加 serial schedule 不如 free training；budget annealing 能把已经学到的机制迁移到新 loop contract，在报告的 4/4 seeds 中成功，绕开了 from-scratch seed lottery。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读，约 1.5–2 小时。先看引言中对 tail instruments 失效的论证，这是理解全篇的入口。然后看 §4–§5：τ(n,i) 的定义、固定点附近诊断失效的 proposition、streaming positive control，以及 16-seed races 中 head instrument 如何预测泛化。§6 是核心实验，重点看 budget law、linear frontier、标准深度 Transformer 与 weight-tied looped Transformer 的对照，以及 NoPE / positional encoding / input injection 控制。§7 的 budget annealing 对训练 recipe 最有参考价值，说明机制可以在 loop budget 之间迁移。附录 C 和 D 值得扫读：C 展示 tail metrics 为什么不可靠，D 处理位置编码控制。最值得深挖的问题是：线性 frontier 是任务和架构共同诱导的优化偏置，还是 looped Transformer 在更大规模语言建模中也会出现的默认解。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks when a weight-tied looped Transformer, obtained by applying the same block for T recurrent steps, actually implements an algorithm. The target distinction is concrete: does the model use a constant-step shortcut, a logarithmic-depth parallel scan, or a linear step-indexed serial computation that can benefit from additional test-time loops?
summary_en.importance: This is a must-read for researchers interested in adaptive compute, recurrent depth, and latent reasoning. The central contribution is not only an empirical finding, but a measurement correction: common end-of-trajectory diagnostics can make non-algorithmic or early-finishing models look algorithmic. The results also show that the training contract controls the speed of the learned computation frontier, and that weight tying changes the optimization prior relative to standard-depth Transformers. This matters for pretraining because looped models are often motivated by test-time compute scaling, but the learned mechanism is determined by the contract used during training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The architecture repeatedly applies one Transformer block Fθ to a hidden state, h^{t+1}=Fθ(h^t,e), with optional input injection through a learned adapter. The main grid uses NoPE, with positional-encoding controls in the appendix. The key methodological move is to replace tail instruments with a head instrument. Tail instruments such as skipping a late loop or comparing Jacobians across late loops are unreliable because converged trajectories sit near fixed points; near such states, skipping is cheap and local circuits look similar by construction. The proposed diagnostic is convergence-time scaling τ(n,i): the first loop at which the decoded output at position i reaches its final value and stays there. Its scaling class acts as a mechanism signature. Constant τ indicates shortcut or refinement, τ proportional to log n indicates a parallel scan, and τ proportional to n indicates serial step-indexed computation. A streaming positive control validates the instrument: when token i is revealed only at loop i, τ recovers a linear slope of 1.0, while shortcut controls remain flat.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are controlled population studies over many seeds, recipes, and model sizes. The reported scales include a small model with a 2-layer block and d=128, a medium model with a 2-layer block and d=256, and a larger model with a 4-layer block and d=512. Tasks include prefix parity, LSB-first increment-with-carry, and group word problems over Z60, S4, S5, and A5. These tasks have known algorithmic structure: some admit constant-depth shortcuts, while S5 and A5 connect to NC1-complete word problems, and associative scan gives a logarithmic-depth solution in principle. The main empirical result is a linear computation frontier learned by free training. The frontier solves v positions per loop, with v approximately n_tr/T_tr; under T=n training, the speed is about 1 position per loop. Giving more loops at test time rescues late positions at fixed input length. Standard tail diagnostics fail: skip retention is essentially total on sufficiently solved examples, cross-step Jacobian alignment is uniformly high, and these metrics do not predict length generalization. The study also separates optimization walls from circuit complexity: A5 hardness is not the main barrier, while S5 operator scale is; an operator-first curriculum removes that wall. Budget annealing transfers the learned mechanism across loop contracts in 4 out of 4 seeds, avoiding the from-scratch seed lottery.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully, allocating roughly 1.5–2 hours. Start with the argument that tail diagnostics become blind near fixed points. Then focus on Sections 4–5 for the τ(n,i) instrument, the saturation proposition, the streaming positive control, and the seed-level prediction experiments. Section 6 contains the main empirical payload: the budget law, the linear frontier, and comparisons between standard-depth and weight-tied looped Transformers. Section 7 is especially relevant for training recipes because budget annealing shows that the mechanism can be moved across loop budgets. Appendices C and D are useful for checking why tail metrics fail and how positional encoding affects the conclusions. The most important open question is whether the same linear-frontier bias appears in larger-scale language modeling, where the task distribution is less controlled and intermediate correctness is not directly supervised.

recommendation.zh: 会改变对 looped Transformer 的 prior：不是多给循环就会自发学算法，应复现预算律和 halting rule。
recommendation.en: This changes the prior on looped Transformers: recurrence alone does not choose the algorithm; reproduce the budget law and halting rule.

paper.title: The Devil is in the Spectrum: Mitigating Representation Collapse in LLMs via Topologically Regularized Side-Path
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are fundamentally limited by representation collapse, a bottleneck that severely degrades long-context performance. We identify that existing approaches risk drifting into one of two pathological extremes: homogenization collapse (e.g., attention sinks causing rank deficiency) and isolation collapse (e.g., local attention causing context disconnection). Through spectral analysis of attention dynamics, we derive an intrinsic trade-off between mixing efficiency (spectr

summary.core_problem: 长上下文Transformer的注意力机制存在两类极端表征崩溃——过度混合导致的均质化崩溃（如注意力Sink现象，表征秩极低）与混合不足导致的隔离崩溃（如局部注意力，远距信息断开），标准注意力设计无法在谱层面同时兼顾混合效率与信息容量，难以规避两类病理。
summary.importance: 将此前分散讨论的注意力Sink、秩崩溃、局部注意力信息隔离等现象统一到注意力转移算子的谱分析框架下，推导了谱间隙（混合效率）与有效秩（信息容量）的定量权衡关系，为理解深度Transformer堆叠过程中的信息传播退化提供了统一的分析视角；提出的非侵入式侧路方案工程改动量小，为长上下文架构改进提供了可参考的方向，但目前公开结果缺少大规模从零预训练验证，结论的普适性有待确认。
summary.technical_approach: 首先对注意力的行归一化转移算子做奇异值分解，推导得到有效秩与谱间隙的定量关系：提升谱间隙会天然压缩奇异值尾部能量、降低有效秩，若不显式保留尾部谱分量，模型必然落入两类崩溃之一。基于该权衡提出拓扑正则化侧路（TRSP）：在不改动原有注意力计算的前提下，并行加入一条无参数的Triangular Box分支，通过级联因果盒式滤波、随层指数扩张带宽，构建从近邻耦合到远距捷径的多尺度传播路径；再搭配仅含约50个可学习参数的长上下文门控，根据上下文长度和层深度调节侧路注入强度，引导算子达到谱平衡。
summary.experiments: 在MMLU、HellaSwag等通用能力基准（后训练场景）和RULER、NoLiMa等长上下文外推基准（覆盖持续预训练和后训练场景）上测试，TRSP未造成通用能力明显下降；在8倍训练长度的NoLiMa长上下文外推测试中保持83%准确率，比Differential Transformer、Gated Attention分别高约30和50个百分点；谱测量显示TRSP可同时提升转移算子的谱间隙和有效秩，避免两类崩溃极端。目前公开的正文内容未涉及大规模从零开始预训练的验证结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计阅读时间20分钟。重点关注引言和方法开头的谱分析部分，尤其是两类表征崩溃的统一刻画、谱间隙与有效秩的权衡推导，这是最具参考价值的概念性洞见；TRSP的具体实现和实验部分可快速浏览，注意其缺少大规模预训练验证的局限性，无需深究工程实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context Transformer attention suffers from two extreme forms of representation collapse—homogenization collapse from over-mixing (e.g., attention sinks, extremely low representation rank) and isolation collapse from under-mixing (e.g., local attention, disconnected long-range information flow)—and standard attention designs cannot spectrally balance mixing efficiency and information capacity to avoid both pathologies.
summary_en.importance: This work unifies previously disconnected observations of attention sinks, rank collapse, and local attention information isolation under a single spectral analysis framework for the attention transition operator, and derives a quantitative trade-off between spectral gap (mixing efficiency) and effective rank (information capacity). This unified view provides useful intuition for understanding information propagation degradation in deep Transformer stacks. The proposed non-invasive side-path intervention requires minimal engineering changes and offers a practical direction for long-context architecture improvements, though available results lack large-scale from-scratch pretraining validation, so the generality of conclusions remains unconfirmed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors perform singular value decomposition on the row-normalized attention transition operator, deriving a quantitative relationship between effective rank and spectral gap: increasing spectral gap naturally suppresses tail energy in the singular value distribution and reduces effective rank, so any mechanism that does not explicitly preserve tail spectral components will fall into one of the two collapse regimes. The proposed Topologically Regularized Side-Path (TRSP) runs parallel to unmodified standard attention computations. It consists of two parts: (1) a parameter-free Triangular Box operator, implemented as cascaded causal box filters with exponentially increasing bandwidth across layers, creating a multi-scale propagation path from local proximal coupling to long-distance shortcuts; (2) a lightweight long-context gate with approximately 50 learnable parameters, which adjusts side-path injection strength based on context length and layer depth to steer the operator toward spectral balance.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover general capability benchmarks (MMLU, HellaSwag, tested in post-training scenarios) and long-context extrapolation benchmarks (RULER, NoLiMa, tested in both continued pretraining and post-training scenarios). TRSP introduces no measurable degradation to general capabilities. On NoLiMa tests at 8x the training context length, TRSP retains 83% accuracy, outperforming Differential Transformer and Gated Attention by roughly 30 and 50 percentage points respectively. Spectral measurements confirm TRSP jointly improves spectral gap and effective rank, avoiding both collapse extremes. The publicly available portion of the paper does not report results from large-scale from-scratch pretraining with the proposed method.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in approximately 20 minutes. Focus on the spectral analysis in the introduction and early methodology sections, particularly the unified characterization of the two representation collapse pathologies and the derivation of the spectral gap / effective rank trade-off, which is the most conceptually useful contribution. The concrete TRSP implementation and experiment sections can be scanned quickly, with attention to the limitation that no large-scale from-scratch pretraining results are provided; deep engagement with implementation details is not necessary at this stage.

recommendation.zh: 谱分析视角拆解表征坍缩的两种极端和内在权衡，机制部分值得看；TRSP方案偏工程修补，重点读§3谱分析和Fig.2。
recommendation.en: The spectral decomposition of two collapse modes and their intrinsic trade-off is the valuable part; focus on §3 spectral analysis and Fig. 2, while TRSP itself is more of an engineering patch.

paper.title: Scaling Interpretable Transformers with Parity Bottleneck Layers
paper.abstract: Language models are thought to exhibit the phenomenon of superposition, representing many more features than dimensions in their residual streams. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are designed to recover such features post-hoc, but training models that are interpretable by construction has remained impractical, as a per-layer over-complete bottleneck is prohibitively expensive in both memory and compute. To overcome this issue, we introduce the ParityTransformer, a GPT-2-scale architecture whose inter

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文想解决一个具体问题：能不能把“可解释特征”直接放进 Transformer 的前向计算，而不是训练完 dense LM 后再用 SAE 去拟合激活。难点在于，逐层插入 over-complete bottleneck 会带来很高的参数、显存和带宽成本，过去很难扩到 GPT-2 量级以上。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构侧，而不是训练 recipe。它把 mechanistic interpretability 从后验分析工具推进到模型设计约束：让中间表示天然是宽而稀疏的 code，并让后续计算直接依赖这些 code。代价也很明确：在 1.3B 参数规模下，达到相近能力大约需要 8-14 倍训练成本。这说明“可解释 by construction”目前不是免费午餐，但比完全 weight-sparse 训练的 100-1000 倍成本估计更接近可实验区间。
summary.technical_approach: 核心模块是 Deep Parity Bottleneck。它不学习一个巨大的 over-complete 字典，而是用参数无关的代数构造生成 feature direction。具体做法是用 parity hash function 根据 feature index bits 的奇偶性生成近似正交的符号模式，在芯片上按需计算方向，避免从 HBM 读取大字典。模型还使用层级 MoE 式路由，让激活保持稀疏，只计算被选中的特征。这个设计和 SAE 的区别很关键：SAE 是对冻结模型激活做重构，得到的是 representational features；ParityTransformer 的 sparse code 参与模型自身计算，更接近 computational features。和 Tamkin 等人的宽 codebook bottleneck 相比，它用固定 algebraic dictionary 替代 learned codebook，主要减少字典存储和带宽压力。
summary.experiments: 论文训练了 200M 和 1.3B 参数 ParityTransformer，并和 dense Transformer 以及 dense Transformer + post-hoc SAE 做比较。主要结论是：ParityTransformer 在若干解释性指标上可以匹配或超过 dense+SAE，包括 steering、细粒度 causal intervention、feature absorption。能力侧则有明显 interpretability tax：1.3B 规模下估计需要 8-14 倍训练计算才能达到相近能力。这个数字比普通 dense LM 显著更贵，但也说明该路线还没有落入完全不可训练的区间。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30-45 分钟。重点看 Section 2 的 Deep Parity Bottleneck 定义、parity dictionary 如何生成、稀疏路由如何接入 Transformer 层；再看 Figure 1 理解 bottleneck 的数据流。Section 3 重点看三类解释性实验：steering、causal intervention、feature absorption，以及能力损失和训练成本估计。需要特别留意的是，它证明的不是“特征语义一定更好”，而是把可解释对象从后验 SAE feature 改成了模型计算中真实使用的 sparse code。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether interpretable features can be made part of the Transformer computation itself, rather than recovered after training with sparse autoencoders. The practical obstacle is the cost of adding an over-complete bottleneck at every layer: a learned wide dictionary is expensive in parameters, memory traffic, and training compute.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is architectural. The work turns interpretability into a design constraint on the pretrained model: intermediate states are forced through wide sparse codes that downstream computation actually uses. The cost is explicit. At the 1.3B scale, the authors estimate an 8-14x training cost to reach a comparable capability level. That is a large tax, but still far below the 100-1000x estimates reported for fully weight-sparse interpretable training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key component is the Deep Parity Bottleneck. Instead of storing and learning a large over-complete dictionary, it generates feature directions from a parameter-free algebraic construction. A parity hash computes sign patterns from the parity of selected feature-index bits, giving cheap nearly incoherent directions that can be produced on chip. A hierarchical MoE-style mechanism routes computation through a sparse subset of these directions. This differs from post-hoc SAEs in an important way: SAE features reconstruct frozen activations, while ParityTransformer features are part of the model’s causal computation. It also differs from earlier wide codebook bottlenecks by removing the learned dictionary as a major memory and bandwidth bottleneck.
summary_en.experiments: The authors train 200M and 1.3B parameter ParityTransformers. They compare against dense Transformers and dense Transformers equipped with post-hoc SAEs. The model matches or exceeds the dense+SAE baseline on several interpretability-oriented evaluations, including steering, fine-grained causal interventions, and feature absorption. On capability, the price is substantial: the estimated training cost for comparable performance is 8-14x at 1.3B parameters.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30-45 minutes. Read Section 2 for the Deep Parity Bottleneck, the parity-based dictionary construction, and how the sparse routing is inserted into Transformer blocks. Figure 1 is the quickest way to understand the data path. In Section 3, focus on the steering, causal intervention, and feature absorption experiments, then check the compute/capability tradeoff. The key question to keep in mind is not whether the features look semantic, but whether the sparse codes are actually used by the model’s computation.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构和实验消融；若固定代数字典不明显伤 LM loss，这会改变对“可解释结构必然太贵”的判断。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture and ablations; if the fixed algebraic dictionary preserves LM loss, it weakens the prior that interpretable structure is necessarily too expensive.

paper.title: The Giant Hippocampus: From Structural Monoculture to a System of Systems
paper.abstract: AI researchers describe state-of-the-art models as one thing repeated at scale: the Transformer, wired identically for text, pixels, or speech. Neuroscientists describe the cortex as a mosaic - dense Layer 4 in visual cortex for spatial encoding, thick Layers 5/6 in motion cortex for temporal integration - different jobs solved by different structures. This paper argues the gap is a structural error, not a stylistic one, and is measurable. A century of cytoarchitecture, from Brodmann to single-c

summary.core_problem: 批评当前大模型过度依赖单一 Transformer 模板，主张用更异构的“系统之系统”结构来匹配不同认知功能。
summary.importance: 贡献类型更接近架构观点和研究议程，而不是可复现实验结果。它把神经科学中的皮层分区、细胞结构差异和 AI 架构单一化之间建立类比，提醒大模型研究不要把规模化同构堆叠当作唯一默认路径。
summary.technical_approach: 论文主要采用论证式方法：引用 Brodmann 分区、Patch-seq 等神经科学证据，说明不同认知功能往往对应不同结构；再用 CNN 的局部感受野和层级深度作为 AI 里结构先验有效的例子，反推 Transformer 的流行部分来自硬件和工程路径依赖，而不一定是原则上最优的认知架构。
summary.experiments: 摘要未显示新的模型训练、参数规模、数据规模或定量实验。证据主要来自已有神经科学文献、CNN 历史经验和对 Transformer 规模化范式的概念分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that modern AI relies too heavily on a single repeated Transformer template and should move toward heterogeneous system-of-systems architectures for different cognitive functions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is closer to an architectural position piece than an empirical result. It uses neuroscience evidence on cortical specialization to challenge the assumption that scaling one homogeneous template is the right default for intelligence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a conceptual argument from cytoarchitecture, Brodmann areas, Patch-seq evidence, and the historical success of CNN structural priors. It frames the Transformer’s dominance partly as a hardware and tooling path dependency rather than a principled architectural endpoint.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report new model training, parameter counts, datasets, or quantitative benchmarks. The evidence appears to be literature-based and historical rather than experimental.

recommendation.zh: 可作架构 taste 的反面提醒，但没有实验闭环；扫摘要和结论即可，不应改变预训练路线。
recommendation.en: Useful as an architectural cautionary note, but with no experimental loop; skim the abstract and conclusion, not a basis for changing a pretraining roadmap.

paper.title: MUX: Continuous Reasoning via Multiplexed Tokens
paper.abstract: Language models solve complex problems by articulating intermediate reasoning steps in natural language. While effective, this process is computationally bottlenecked: each reasoning step conveys only a single subword, and many are spent expressing a thought instead of carrying out computation. We propose MUX, a simple method for high-bandwidth and compact reasoning based on distillation of discrete reasoning into continuous multiplexed tokens in a latent space. Here, each latent token is traine

summary.core_problem: 离散 CoT 推理把“思考”编码成逐 token 的自然语言，带宽低、冗余高；而连续 latent reasoning 虽然带宽高，但训练容易出现 latent collapse/shortcut（学到无信息的隐变量）。论文要解决的是：在不引入复杂辅助解码器的前提下，给连续推理一个既局部可监督、又能避免坍塌、还允许表达多假设并行的训练目标。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的启发主要在两点：
1) 把“连续推理监督”问题转成一个通信/编码问题：如何用固定维度向量无损表示可变长离散符号序列。这为 latent reasoning 的目标设计提供了更可分析的约束（lossless encoding），比纯经验式的 distillation 更可控。
2) 如果 latent token 能稳定承载多个离散 token 的信息，推理阶段可能用更短的轨迹完成同等计算，潜在影响是降低推理 token 成本、以及为搜索/规划提供更高带宽的内部状态表示（虽然这更偏推理范式而非传统 next-token 预训练）。
summary.technical_approach:
MUX 的核心是“复用/叠加式监督目标”（multiplexed targets）：
- 给定离散推理序列 r（由 subword 组成），把它切成若干 span；每个 latent token 对应一个 span。
- 对 span 内每个离散 subword，取其 one-hot（在词表空间），再用位置相关权重做线性叠加，得到一个词表维度的连续向量目标 t（本质是一个加权的多峰分布/logit 目标）。
- 模型用一个 linear+softmax head 预测词表分布，与 t 做 KL loss（局部监督），从而让一个 latent token“同时携带”该 span 的多个离散 token 信息。

关键点在于“lossless by construction”：论文给出一类权重设计（几何衰减、正弦、rotary 等），满足 subset-sum separation 条件，使得叠加后的目标可以被唯一解码回原 span（demultiplexing）。直觉是：不同位置的权重组合在数值上可分离，避免不同 token 序列映射到同一个叠加向量，从源头减少监督歧义。

此外，论文讨论 multiplexing 的“天然叠加”如何表达多假设：在需要 BFS 的任务中，一个 latent token 可以表示并更新多个候选状态（以叠加形式共存），从而用串行 token 实现并行搜索的效果（理论表达性论证 + 实验验证）。
summary.experiments:
论文宣称的主要结果：
- 在 32 个数学推理设置上（两套训练语料、四个语言模型、四个测试集的组合），MUX 在 latent reasoning 方法中整体最好，并且在部分设置上超过强离散/连续基线。
- 在两个搜索类 benchmark 上，MUX 超过离散与连续推理基线，支持其“并行搜索表征”的主张。
- 通过 probing 分析，latent token 可解码出可解释的推理内容，并且对最终答案预测有实质贡献。

（注：你提供的全文片段未包含具体模型规模、训练 token、各基线名称与逐项数值表；若要写到精确提升幅度与统计显著性，需要补充实验章节/附录表格。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（skim）：
- 先读方法定义部分：multiplexed target 如何从离散 span 构造、KL 监督怎么接到模型输出头上。把“一个 latent token 对应一个 span”的对齐关系看清楚。
- 再读“lossless multiplexing”的条件与权重族（几何/正弦/rotary）那一节：这是它区别于一般 soft distillation 的关键，也是避免 latent collapse 的主要论据。
- 最后看 BFS 表达性论证与对应实验，判断它对你关心的规划/搜索任务是否真有增益。
预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟可理解核心机制；若要复现，需要精读权重参数化、span 切分策略、以及 demultiplexing/探针实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete chain-of-thought reasoning is low-bandwidth and verbose, while continuous latent reasoning is high-bandwidth but notoriously hard to train due to collapse/shortcut latents. The paper targets a concrete question: what local supervision signal can train latent reasoning tokens to faithfully represent discrete reasoning spans, without auxiliary autoregressive decoders and while still supporting multi-hypothesis representations useful for search?
summary_en.importance:
Two takeaways matter for foundation-model work:
1) It reframes latent-reasoning supervision as an encoding/communication problem: how to represent a variable-length categorical sequence with a fixed-dimensional continuous token in a provably decodable way. This adds analyzable constraints (lossless encoding) to an area often driven by heuristics.
2) If a latent token can reliably carry multiple discrete subwords, reasoning trajectories can be shorter for the same computation, potentially reducing inference-time token costs and enabling richer internal state updates for planning/search (more a modeling paradigm shift than classic next-token pretraining, but still relevant to future pretraining objectives).
summary_en.technical_approach:
MUX trains each latent reasoning token to match a multiplexed vocabulary-space target built from a span of discrete reasoning tokens:
- Take the one-hot vectors of the subwords in a span.
- Apply position-dependent weights and linearly superpose them into a single vocabulary-dimensional target vector.
- Predict this target with a linear+softmax head and optimize a KL loss (local distillation).

A central claim is “lossless by construction”: the paper provides families of weighting schemes (geometric decay, sinusoidal, rotary-like) that satisfy a subset-sum separation condition, making the superposition uniquely decodable back into the original discrete span (demultiplexing). This is used to argue against ambiguous supervision and to mitigate latent collapse.

The paper also argues that superposition naturally supports representing multiple hypotheses; for BFS-style problems, a single latent token can encode and update multiple candidate states in parallel (expressivity argument plus empirical support).
summary_en.experiments:
Reported results:
- Best-performing latent reasoning method across 32 math-reasoning settings (two training corpora × four LMs × four test sets).
- Outperforms strong discrete and continuous baselines on two search benchmarks, aligning with the multi-hypothesis/BFS motivation.
- Probing suggests latent tokens encode interpretable reasoning content and materially affect final answer prediction.

(The provided excerpt does not include exact model sizes, training budgets, baseline lists, or per-benchmark numeric tables; those are needed for precise deltas and reproducibility details.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the construction of multiplexed targets and the KL training objective first; ensure you understand the span-to-latent alignment.
- Then focus on the “lossless multiplexing” section: the separation condition and the concrete weighting families (geometric/sinusoidal/rotary). This is the main technical differentiator.
- Finally, check the BFS expressivity argument and the corresponding experiments to judge whether the search benefits are real for your use cases.
Time: ~30–45 minutes for core understanding; reproduction requires careful reading of span segmentation, weighting hyperparameters, and demultiplexing/probing procedures.

recommendation.zh: 这类“连续潜变量推理”值得盯，但先别急着改 prior；重点看可逆性证明和 ablation，若 recovery 不稳，它更像漂亮的表示技巧而不是新推理范式。
recommendation.en: Worth tracking as latent-reasoning work, but don’t update priors too fast; read the reversibility proof and ablations first—if recovery is brittle, this is a neat representation trick, not a new reasoning paradigm.

paper.title: Kernelized Linear Attention: Breaking the Capacity Wall with Symmetric Cones
paper.abstract: Linear attention promises constant-time recurrent inference but degrades sharply on associative recall. We formulate attention recall as a spherical-packing problem and introduce Kernelized Linear Attention Activations (KATA), a framework whose feature maps are derived from first principles by certifying nonnegative attention weights through a self-dual homogeneous cone. Building on this observation, we show that rank-one positive semi-definite (PSD) features offer a favorable capacity--interfer

summary.core_problem: 线性注意力虽能实现常数时间循环推理，但在联想召回任务上性能急剧下降，存在明确的容量瓶颈，现有设计多为启发式，缺乏理论支撑。
