Learns shared token-position factors together with order-absorption vectors to encode embeddings of different n-gram orders. Novel design shift from independent hash tables to shared factor representations.
summary_en.experiments: Comprehensive experiments against Engram-style n-gram modules: TN-gram matches or outperforms while using far fewer parameters. Specific model sizes and training datasets not disclosed in abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliations and notable author backgrounds not identifiable from the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 对token表示和多token模式建模有参考价值，但工程属性强于理论突破；作为architecture文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: Interesting for token representation and multi-token pattern modeling but more engineering than theoretical insight—keep as literature reference, no need to read in full.

paper.title: DAG-MoE: From Simple Mixture to Structural Aggregation in Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become a leading approach for decoupling parameter count from computational cost in large language models, yet effectively scaling MoE performance remains a challenge. Prior work shows that fine-grained experts enlarge the space of expert combinations and improve flexibility, but they also impose substantial routing overhead, creating a new scalability bottleneck. In this paper, we explore a complementary axis for scaling -- how expert outputs are aggregated.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“如何选专家”，而是标准 MoE 里长期被默认固定的一步：被选中的 top-K 专家输出该如何组合。传统 MoE 用 router 分数做加权求和，这种聚合是置换不变的，只关心选中了哪些专家，不关心它们之间的顺序、角色和相互作用。作者指出，这会把 MoE 的表达能力限制在“专家集合的线性混合”上，即便 router 和 expert 本身都很强，聚合形式仍然是瓶颈。论文要解决的核心问题，是在不增加 router 复杂度、也不改 expert 基本形态的前提下，给 MoE 引入更强的组合表达能力，让同一组专家能够形成不同的结构化计算路径，而不是只做一次平坦求和。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究的启发主要有两点。第一，它把 MoE 的扩展轴从“更多专家、更细粒度路由”转向“更强的聚合结构”，这对当前 router 开销、负载均衡和通信已经成为实际瓶颈的 MoE 训练很有现实意义。第二，它提出一个很清楚的观点：MoE 的容量不只来自 expert 数量和路由稀疏度，也来自 expert 之间的组合算子。这个视角对后续做层内组合计算、层内 reasoning、甚至把 MoE 看成可学习程序图都有启发。不过从量级上看，这更像是一个有意思的架构增量，而不是会立刻改写大规模预训练 recipe 的结果。它值得关注，但还没有到必须重估主流 MoE 训练范式的程度。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把 top-K 专家的聚合从 weighted sum 改成一个可学习的 DAG 结构聚合。输入 token 先经过常规 router 选出 top-K 专家，这一步与标准 MoE 保持一致，因此不会引入额外的 router-side 选择复杂度。不同之处在于，作者为这 K 个专家再学习一个有向无环图，给每个专家分配结构角色，并沿 DAG 进行多步表示更新与聚合。

从设计动机看，作者认为标准加权和有两个限制。其一，置换不变，无法表达“先由专家 A 处理，再由专家 B 基于 A 的结果继续处理”这类有序组合。其二，所有专家输出都直接投到最终表示，缺少中间状态，因此难以在单层内近似多步推理。DAG 聚合则允许某些专家输出先作为中间节点，再被后续节点吸收，从而把单层 MoE 从一次混合扩展为一段短计算图。

论文的理论部分主要论证两件事。第一，在 expert 和 router 固定时，引入结构后，可区分的 expert 组合空间会比简单求和更大，因为同一组专家在不同 DAG 排列下会产生不同函数。第二，这种结构化聚合可以在单层中近似某些组合式计算，作者用动态规划类问题作为直观例子，说明 DAG 比平坦混合更适合表达分步依赖。

实现上，DAG 学习模块是轻量的。它只在已选中的 K 个专家之间建图，而不是在全部 N 个专家上做全局结构搜索，因此额外代价主要与 K 有关，而不是与总专家数 N 线性放大。这一点很关键，因为作者的卖点之一就是：相比继续增大 N、K 来追求更细粒度组合，DAG-MoE 试图在固定 top-K 下提升组合表达力。就方法定位而言，它不是替代 sparse routing，而是替代 sparse routing 之后那一步过于简单的 aggregation。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，实验覆盖语言建模和若干下游任务，结论是 DAG-MoE 相比标准 top-K 加权和 MoE 有稳定增益，且这种增益在不改变 router/expert 主体配置时依然存在。论文强调的不是单点峰值，而是“在相同专家选择条件下，仅替换聚合方式即可提升性能”。

更值得看的其实是消融，而不是主表。几个关键观察如下：
1. 当 expert 粒度不能继续细化、或者 router 开销已经接近瓶颈时，DAG 聚合仍能继续带来收益，说明它确实提供了独立于 granularity 的扩展轴。
2. 与简单的加深 FFN、增加 expert 数、增加 active experts 相比，结构化聚合在参数和路由复杂度更受控的情况下取得更好的性价比。
3. 若去掉 DAG 学习、退化成无结构或固定结构聚合，性能会回落，说明收益不只是“多做了几步计算”，而是来自可学习的专家间依赖。
4. 论文还展示了 DAG 在某些具有组合结构的任务上更明显，这与作者关于“单层近似多步 reasoning”的论点一致。

你给出的全文片段没有包含完整主表和具体数值，因此这里不能编造参数量、数据规模和提升幅度。阅读时建议直接核对实验章节中的 backbone 规模、expert 数 N、active K、hidden size 对齐方式，以及训练 FLOPs 是否严格匹配；这决定了结论到底是“结构更好”，还是“实际算力更多”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三处。第一，看引言和方法开头，理解作者为什么把问题定义为 aggregation bottleneck，而不是 routing bottleneck。第二，看理论分析部分，重点不是证明是否绝对严密，而是它如何形式化“同一组专家在不同结构下可表达不同函数”。第三，看消融表，尤其是与 standard MoE、fine-grained MoE、固定结构聚合的对比。

如果时间有限，优先看：方法图、DAG 学习模块的伪代码或公式、主结果表、以及关于不同 K/N/粒度设置的消融。预计 25 到 40 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。

真正值得深挖的点有两个。一个是训练稳定性：DAG 结构是否会放大 MoE 已有的 load imbalance、梯度方差或 token-level 不稳定。另一个是系统代价：虽然它不增加 router 复杂度，但会不会增加 expert 间同步和 kernel 实现难度。若想判断它是否适合大规模预训练，这两点比小规模 benchmark 提升更重要。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a neglected part of MoE design: aggregation after routing. Standard MoE selects top-K experts and combines their outputs with a weighted sum. That operation is permutation-invariant, so it only depends on the selected set, not on order, role, or interaction among experts. The authors argue that this makes aggregation itself an expressivity bottleneck. The core problem is therefore how to increase the compositional capacity of MoE without changing the router, without redesigning experts, and without paying the routing-side cost of ever finer-grained expert configurations.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining researchers is conceptual. It shifts one scaling axis of MoE from “more experts / more active experts” to “better composition of the same selected experts.” That matters because router complexity, load balancing, and communication are already practical bottlenecks in large MoE training. The paper also makes a useful point: MoE capacity is not only about expert count and sparsity, but also about the operator used to compose expert outputs. That said, this looks more like a meaningful architectural extension than a result that immediately changes mainstream large-scale MoE recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
DAG-MoE replaces the standard weighted-sum aggregation with a learned directed acyclic graph over the selected top-K experts. Routing remains unchanged: a conventional sparse router picks the top-K experts for each token. The new part is a lightweight DAG-learning module that assigns structural roles to those K experts and aggregates them through iterative updates along the learned graph.

The motivation is straightforward. Weighted summation cannot express ordered compositions such as “expert A processes first, expert B refines based on A.” It also lacks intermediate states, since every expert output is projected directly into the final mixture. By introducing a DAG, the model can form short computation chains inside a single MoE layer, where some expert outputs become intermediate nodes consumed by later experts.

The theoretical argument is that, with experts and router fixed, structural aggregation enlarges the effective combination space. The same set of selected experts can now realize different functions depending on graph structure, whereas weighted sum collapses all permutations into one. The paper further argues that this enables a form of approximate multi-step reasoning within one layer, especially for compositional problems such as dynamic-programming-like computations.

Implementation-wise, the design is intentionally local. The graph is learned only among the selected K experts, not over all N experts. This keeps the extra cost tied to K rather than to the full expert pool. That design choice is central: the paper is not trying to replace sparse routing, but to replace the overly simple aggregation that follows sparse routing.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover language modeling and downstream tasks, and the consistent message is that DAG-MoE improves over standard MoE when the router and expert backbone are otherwise kept comparable. The key claim is not a single headline number, but that changing only the aggregation mechanism can produce gains under the same expert-selection setup.

The most informative part is the ablation section. Several takeaways matter:
1. DAG aggregation still helps when expert granularity cannot be pushed further or when routing overhead is already a bottleneck, suggesting it is a genuinely different scaling axis.
2. Compared with simply increasing expert count, active experts, or FFN depth, structural aggregation appears to offer a better trade-off under controlled routing complexity.
3. Removing DAG learning or replacing it with unstructured/fixed aggregation degrades performance, which suggests the gain is not merely from extra computation steps but from learned inter-expert dependencies.
4. The advantage is more visible on tasks with stronger compositional structure, which is aligned with the paper’s “single-layer multi-step reasoning” argument.

The provided full-content excerpt does not include the complete result tables or exact numbers, so it would be unsafe to invent parameter counts, data sizes, or deltas. When reading, it is important to verify whether FLOPs, active experts, and hidden sizes are tightly matched; otherwise the improvement could partly come from extra effective compute rather than aggregation alone.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and early method section to understand why the paper frames aggregation, not routing, as the bottleneck. Second, read the theory section for the exact sense in which structure enlarges the combination space. Third, inspect the ablations against standard MoE, fine-grained MoE, and fixed-structure variants.

If time is limited, prioritize the architecture figure, the DAG-learning equations or pseudocode, the main result table, and the ablations over K/N/granularity settings. A useful skim should take around 25–40 minutes.

Two deeper questions are worth following up. One is training stability: whether DAG aggregation amplifies existing MoE issues such as imbalance or gradient variance. The other is systems cost: even if router complexity is unchanged, the graph-based aggregation may complicate synchronization and kernel efficiency. Those two points matter more than small benchmark gains if the goal is large-scale pretraining adoption.

recommendation.zh: MoE聚合方式的新颖思路，跳出'路由+加权求和'的固定框架，值得在内部MoE架构实验中参考，重点看理论证明和聚合结构设计部分。
recommendation.en: Novel angle on MoE aggregation, moving beyond router + weighted-sum. Worth referencing in internal MoE architecture experiments; focus on theoretical proof and aggregation design.

paper.title: Beyond Sinusoids: A Morlet Wavelet Framework for Transformer Positional Encoding

summary.core_problem: Transformer中标准正弦位置编码（Sinusoidal PE）在长外推和多尺度序列建模上存在局限，RoPE虽广泛使用但也有衰减特性的内在约束。
summary.importance: 首次系统提出用Morlet小波替代正弦基的位置编码框架（Beyond Sinusoids），为位置编码设计提供新的数学家族。
summary.technical_approach: 将位置编码从正弦基替换为Morlet小波基，利用小波的多尺度分析特性更好地捕捉不同距离的位置依赖，同时保留了与自注意力机制的兼容性。
summary.experiments: 摘要中未披露具体实验数据，需读正文评估在语言建模任务上的PPL和下游效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard sinusoidal positional encoding in Transformers has limitations in long extrapolation and multi-scale sequence modeling; RoPE, while widely used, also has inherent constraints on decay characteristics.
summary_en.importance: First systematic proposal of a Morlet wavelet-based positional encoding framework (Beyond Sinusoids), providing a new mathematical family for positional encoding design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Replaces sinusoidal basis functions with Morlet wavelet basis functions for positional encoding, leveraging the multi-scale analysis property of wavelets to better capture positional dependencies at different distances while preserving compatibility with self-attention.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental data disclosed in abstract; need to read main text to evaluate PPL and downstream performance on language modeling tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Athanasios Zeris; institution not explicitly stated.

recommendation.zh: 位置编码的数学替代方案，Morlet小波是合理候选但需复现验证；建议先看实验部分是否在标准基准上优于RoPE再决定是否深入。
recommendation.en: A mathematical alternative for positional encoding; Morlet wavelet is a plausible candidate but needs replication. Suggest checking experiments section first to see if it outperforms RoPE on standard benchmarks before deep diving.

paper.title: Revisiting Padded Transformer Expressivity: Which Architectural Choices Matter and Which Don't
paper.abstract: Recent work describes what transformers can and cannot compute through connections to boolean circuits, but existing results lack exact characterizations and are sensitive to modeling choices. Padded transformers -- to whose input filler symbols such as ``...'' are appended -- emerge as a useful gadget for establishing equivalences to circuit classes by providing polynomial space for adaptive parallel computation. However, only a limited set of padded transformer idealizations has been studied,

summary.core_problem: Transformer表达性理论研究结果高度依赖具体建模假设（如soft vs hard注意力、数值精度），导致结论零散且难以调和。本文系统研究padded transformer（在输入后附加多项式数量填充符号的Transformer）在不同架构选择下的表达性鲁棒性，并将其与布尔电路类建立精确对应关系。
summary.importance: 对预训练架构研究提供理论参考：填充机制（如pause token、扩散语言模型中的自适应推理步数）带来的表达性提升在不同注意力类型和宽度下是稳健的，但数值精度和深度才是最终瓶颈。这提示实践中增加填充/推理步长可能比调整注意力类型或宽度更有效。
summary.technical_approach: 系统分析L-一致多项式padded transformer族（L-uniform指参数可由logspace图灵机构造）的表达性，考察三个维度：(1)注意力类型——softmax(SMAT) vs 平均硬注意力(AHAT)；(2)数值精度、宽度、深度的缩放；(3)参数一致性条件。通过将AHAT模拟为SMAT、将SMAT结果迁移至AHAT、扩展已有结论，统一了先前分散的刻画。发现一旦达到对数精度，注意力类型、宽度甚至进一步提高精度都不改变表达性；而对数精度padded transformer严格强于常数精度版本，且表达性随深度增长。
summary.experiments: 纯理论分析，无实证实验。通过构造性证明建立了多种padded transformer变体与AC^d/TC^d等自然电路类之间的等价关系。核心技术贡献是将London & Kanade(2025)对SMAT的刻画与Merrill & Sabharwal(2025)对AHAT的刻画统一起来，证明在对数精度下二者等价。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看Fig.1的全景图快速把握结果结构（不同假设下的表达性等价类）。核心阅读章节是：第3章AHAT与SMAT的互模拟构造，第4章精度对表达性的影响，第5章深度的作用。阅读难度较高（理论CS/TCS风格），需具备计算复杂度理论基础。建议跳过冗长的形式化证明，聚焦main theorem的陈述和讨论（约30-45分钟）。
summary.authors_note: 无法从提供内容中确认具体作者与机构

summary_en.core_problem: Transformer expressivity results are highly sensitive to modeling choices (soft vs hard attention, numeric precision), yielding fragmented and hard-to-reconcile conclusions. This paper systematically studies the robustness of padded transformers (transformers with polynomially many filler symbols appended to input) across architectural choices and establishes exact correspondences to boolean circuit classes.
summary_en.importance: Provides theoretical grounding for architecture design in pretraining: the expressivity gain from padding (related to pause tokens, adaptive inference steps in diffusion LMs) is robust across attention types and widths, but numeric precision and depth are the ultimate bottlenecks. This suggests that adding padding/inference steps may be more effective than tuning attention type or width.
summary_en.technical_approach: Systematically analyzes the expressivity of L-uniform polynomial padded transformer families (L-uniform: parameters constructible by a logspace Turing machine) across three axes: (1) attention type — softmax (SMAT) vs average hard attention (AHAT); (2) scaling of numeric precision, width, and depth; (3) uniformity conditions. Unifies prior disparate characterizations by constructing mutual simulations between AHAT and SMAT, translating SMAT results to AHAT, and extending existing work. Key finding: once logarithmic precision is achieved, attention type, width, and further precision increases do not alter expressivity; log-precision padded transformers are strictly more expressive than constant-precision ones, and expressivity grows with depth.
summary_en.experiments: Pure theoretical analysis — no empirical experiments. Results are constructive proofs establishing equivalences between various padded transformer variants and natural circuit classes (AC^d, TC^d). Unifies London & Kanade (2025) on SMAT with Merrill & Sabharwal (2025) on AHAT, proving equivalence under log-precision.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Fig.1 for a panoramic view of the landscape (equivalence classes under different assumptions). Key chapters: §3 AHAT-SMAT mutual simulation, §4 impact of numeric precision, §5 role of depth. High reading difficulty (theoretical CS/TCS style), requires background in computational complexity theory. Skip lengthy formal proofs and focus on main theorem statements and discussion (approx 30-45 min).

recommendation.zh: 读定理表和假设即可；它把“架构细节影响表达力”的 prior 收窄到精度和深度两项。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem table and assumptions; it narrows the expressivity prior from many architectural knobs to mainly precision and depth.

paper.title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
paper.abstract: Linear attention replaces the unbounded cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state, reducing sequence mixing to linear time and decoding to constant memory. The hard part is not just what to forget, but how to edit this compressed memory without scrambling existing associations. Delta-rule models subtract the current read before writing a new value, and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) sharpens forgetting with channel-wise decay. But the active edit still uses a single scalar gate to

summary.core_problem: 线性注意力用固定大小 recurrent state 替代 softmax attention 的无界 KV cache，但压缩记忆的擦除与写入容易互相干扰；论文要解决 DeltaNet/KDA 中 erase 和 write 被同一个门控耦合的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 LLM 架构与序列建模机制改进。它瞄准 linear attention 的核心瓶颈：不是简单降低复杂度，而是在固定容量状态中稳定编辑关联记忆。若实验成立，这类改动会影响长上下文、高吞吐解码和 softmax attention 替代路线的设计。
summary.technical_approach: Gated DeltaNet-2 继承 Gated DeltaNet 的 delta-rule 更新和 Kimi Delta Attention 的 adaptive forgetting、channel-wise decay，但把原先单一标量门控拆成两个 channel-wise 门：key 侧 erase gate b_t 控制旧内容擦除，value 侧 write gate w_t 控制新内容写入。两个门退化为相同标量时可回到 KDA 类设定，因此方法是对既有 DeltaNet/KDA 的结构性泛化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参数规模、训练 token 数、语言建模 perplexity、长上下文 benchmark 或吞吐/显存指标。可确认的实验主张是 Gated DeltaNet-2 针对 DeltaNet 与 KDA 共享的 scalar tie limitation 做消融，关键应看 erase/write 解耦相对单门控和 KDA 的收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a memory-editing problem in linear attention: fixed-size recurrent states reduce memory cost, but DeltaNet/KDA-style updates tie erasing old key-side content and writing new value-side content through a single gate.
summary_en.importance: This is an architecture contribution for language modeling and sequence modeling. It targets the central weakness of linear attention: not just reducing complexity, but editing compressed associative memory without corrupting existing bindings. If the empirical results hold, it matters for long-context and high-throughput alternatives to softmax attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: Gated DeltaNet-2 generalizes Gated DeltaNet and Kimi Delta Attention. It keeps adaptive forgetting and channel-wise decay, but splits the single scalar edit gate into two channel-wise gates: an erase gate b_t on the key side and a write gate w_t on the value side. When the two gates collapse to the same scalar behavior, the update reduces toward the KDA-style formulation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report parameter counts, token budgets, language-modeling perplexity, long-context benchmarks, or throughput and memory numbers. The key empirical question is the ablation of decoupled erase/write gates against single-gate DeltaNet and KDA variants.

recommendation.zh: 优先看消融表；erase/write 解耦是干净的架构假设，若小模型到长上下文都稳，应进内部复现。
recommendation.en: Prioritize the ablations; erase/write decoupling is a clean architectural hypothesis, and if it holds across scale and context length it deserves internal replication.

paper.title: Rethinking Cross-Layer Information Routing in Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a de facto backbone of modern visual generation, and nearly every major axis of their design -- tokenization, attention, conditioning, objectives, and latent autoencoders -- has been extensively revisited. The residual stream that governs how information accumulates across layers, however, has been directly inherited from the original Transformer. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical analysis of cross-layer information flow in DiTs, jointly a

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 DiT 中跨层信息如何流动。问题不在 attention、tokenizer 或 diffusion objective，而在 Transformer 继承来的 PreNorm residual stream：逐层残差相加会在 DiT 的深度维度和 denoising timestep 维度上造成表示幅值膨胀、梯度衰减和层间冗余。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏架构诊断和改造的工作，对 LLM 基座研究也有参考价值。它把 LLM 中讨论过的 PreNorm dilution 现象放到 diffusion transformer 里重新审视，并指出 DiT 多了一个关键变量：噪声时间步。高噪声阶段更依赖粗结构，低噪声阶段更依赖细节，固定的逐层相加不一定适合这种动态过程。这个观察对统一多模态预训练也有启发，因为 AR Transformer 的残差习惯设计在 diffusion / flow / masked 生成模型中未必仍是合适默认项。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先做诊断：沿网络深度和 denoising timestep 分析 hidden-state magnitude、反向梯度和 block-wise redundancy，发现传统 residual addition 带来三类同步出现的问题。随后提出 Diffusion-Adaptive Routing，简称 DAR。DAR 用一个沿深度维度的可学习路由替代固定残差累加：每个子层不再简单接收 running residual，而是对之前子层输出做 softmax attention 聚合。query 来自当前经过 adaLN 调制的 hidden state，因此路由同时依赖内容和 timestep 条件。这个设计区别于 U-Net 式长 skip connection：它不手工指定浅层和深层配对，也不强行恢复固定层级结构，而是在保持 isotropic Transformer stack 的同时做 timestep-adaptive、non-incremental 的跨层聚合。DAR 也可以和 REPA 这类 representation-alignment objective 叠加。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 ImageNet 256×256 上进行。以 SiT-XL/2 为例，DAR 达到 7.56 FID，相比 matched compute 的 vanilla SiT 降低 2.11 FID。训练效率上，DAR 用约 8.75× 更少的训练迭代达到 baseline 的收敛质量。与 REPA 结合时，早期训练相对单独 REPA 还有约 2× 加速。论文还把性能提升和诊断指标联系起来：forward magnitude inflation、backward gradient decay、block redundancy 三个症状在 DAR 下有所缓解，说明改进不是单纯来自参数量或训练噪声，而是与跨层路由机制相关。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到半精读，预计 30–45 分钟。先看诊断图，尤其是 Fig. 2 及对应章节，确认三类 residual 症状如何随 depth 和 timestep 变化。再看 DAR 公式，重点理解它如何用 adaLN-conditioned hidden state 产生 query，以及为什么 softmax over previous layer outputs 比 running residual 更适合 DiT。实验部分重点看 ImageNet 256×256 的 FID / iteration trade-off、DAR 与 REPA 的组合实验，以及诊断指标和生成质量之间的对应关系。值得深挖的问题是：DAR 的深度 attention 是否会引入明显显存开销，以及同类思想能否迁移到 diffusion LM 或 masked LM。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies cross-layer information flow in Diffusion Transformers. The target is not the attention module, tokenization, or diffusion objective, but the inherited PreNorm residual stream. Standard residual addition creates three coupled issues in DiTs: monotonic hidden-state magnitude growth, sharp backward gradient decay, and increasing block-level redundancy.
summary_en.importance: This is an architecture and training-dynamics paper with useful signals for foundation-model research. It revisits a residual-stream issue known from LLMs, but in DiTs the denoising timestep adds an extra axis: high-noise steps emphasize coarse structure, while low-noise steps require fine detail. A fixed, timestep-agnostic residual accumulation rule is therefore a questionable default. The lesson also matters for unified multimodal pretraining, where design choices inherited from autoregressive Transformers may not transfer cleanly to diffusion, flow, or masked generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first diagnoses DiTs along both depth and denoising timestep, measuring hidden-state magnitude, gradient flow, and block-wise redundancy. It then proposes Diffusion-Adaptive Routing, or DAR, as a drop-in replacement for ordinary residual accumulation. Instead of passing a running residual through the stack, each sublayer aggregates previous sublayer outputs through a softmax attention over depth. The query is computed from the current adaLN-modulated hidden state, which gives the routing both content dependence and timestep dependence. This differs from U-Net-style long skip connections: it does not manually pair shallow and deep layers, and it does not impose a fixed hierarchy. It keeps the Transformer stack homogeneous while making cross-layer aggregation learnable, non-incremental, and timestep-adaptive. The method is also compatible with representation-alignment objectives such as REPA.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments are on ImageNet 256×256. With SiT-XL/2, DAR reaches 7.56 FID, improving the matched-compute vanilla SiT baseline by 2.11 FID. It also reaches the baseline’s converged quality with roughly 8.75× fewer training iterations. When combined with REPA, DAR gives about a 2× early-stage training acceleration over REPA alone. The paper further links the quality gains to the diagnostic measurements: DAR reduces the magnitude inflation, gradient decay, and block redundancy observed under the standard residual stream.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim to semi-deep read in about 30–45 minutes. Start with the diagnostic figures, especially Fig. 2 and the related analysis of depth-by-timestep behavior. Then read the DAR formulation carefully: the key is how the adaLN-conditioned hidden state produces the depth-routing query, and why attention over previous sublayer outputs differs from ordinary residual accumulation. In the experiments, focus on the FID-versus-iteration trade-off, the combination with REPA, and the connection between diagnostic metrics and generation quality. A useful follow-up question is whether similar routing can help diffusion LMs or masked language models, and what memory overhead the depth attention introduces.

recommendation.zh: DiT残差信息流的分析对理解扩散模型训练动态有启发，DAR即插即用的设计值得在LLM扩散建模范式中尝试复现。只看§3诊断分析和§4 DAR设计即可。
recommendation.en: The analysis of residual information flow in DiTs sheds light on diffusion model training dynamics; DAR's drop-in design warrants reproduction attempts in diffusion LLM paradigms. Read §3 diagnosis and §4 DAR design only.

paper.title: LT2: Linear-Time Looped Transformers
paper.abstract: Looped Transformers (LT) have emerged as a powerful architecture by iterating their layers multiple times before decoding the final token. However, pairing them with full attention retains quadratic complexity, making them computationally expensive and slow. We introduce LT2 (Linear-Time Looped Transformers), a family of looped architectures that replace quadratic softmax attention with subquadratic, linear-time attention. We study two variants: LT2-linear with linear attention and LT2-sparse wi

summary.core_problem: Looped Transformer 用权重共享把“深度”换成多轮 latent computation，但每一轮仍要做全注意力。这样参数量省下来了，训练 FLOPs、长上下文推理延迟和 KV-cache 却随 loop 次数继续放大。LT2 解决的是这个不匹配：如何让 looped computation 继续保留多轮推理收益，同时把 token mixing 从二次复杂度换成线性或稀疏复杂度。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构和训练成本之间的重新分解。常规深层 Transformer 是用更多独立参数买计算深度，Looped Transformer 是用重复计算买有效深度；LT2 进一步把注意力瓶颈降下来，使“多轮计算”更接近可扩展的训练和推理单元。它的贡献不是提出一个新的预训练目标，而是给 looped/latent reasoning 类架构补上效率短板。对长上下文、小参数强推理、以及从已有全注意力 looped 模型迁移到高效模型，都有直接参考价值。限制也清楚：结果主要说明线性/稀疏 token mixer 在 looped 设置下有协同效应，但更大规模预训练、不同数据配比和更长上下文下的稳定性还需要继续验证。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接：保留 Looped Transformer 的权重共享框架，把每个共享 block 中的 full MHA 替换为线性注意力或稀疏注意力。论文研究了 LT2-linear 和 LT2-sparse 两类。LT2-linear 使用线性注意力类 mixer，通过 recurrent state 在 loop 间被反复更新；loop 不只是重复同一个近似注意力，而是在多轮中细化记忆状态。LT2-sparse 使用稀疏注意力类 mixer，单轮只能看局部或稀疏邻域，但多轮循环会逐步扩大有效感受野。这个点是论文的核心：looping 对 full attention 主要是增加计算深度，对 linear/sparse attention 还会改变可访问上下文的动态。论文还加入零初始化的逐通道门控，使替换 token mixer 时训练更平滑。混合版本 LT2-hybrid 更实用：一种是 GDN + DSA，完全不使用二次复杂度注意力；另一种是 Full + GDN，用少量全注意力层保留全局建模能力，其余用线性 mixer 提供吞吐收益。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了标准零样本评测、语言建模、recall、state-tracking 和效率测试。LT2-hybrid 的 GDN + DSA 版本在不使用 full attention 的情况下，平均 zero-shot 达到 59.3%，与标准 full-attention Looped Transformer 持平；在 8k context、batch size 8 的 decode 设置下，吞吐约 125 tokens/s，而标准 looped transformer 为 22 tokens/s，约 5.7 倍提升。Full + GDN 版本进一步把平均 zero-shot 从 59.3% 提到 61.4%，提升 2.1 点，同时仍保持约 5 倍 decode 吞吐提升。论文还做了从已有 Ouro looped transformer 到 LT2 的转换实验：用约 1B tokens 的 continued training，把 Ouro 转成 Ouro-Hybrid-1.4B，基本保留 full-attention teacher 的质量，同时继承线性时间推理效率。这个实验对工程落地很关键，因为它说明不一定需要从头训练 LT2。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Figure 2，确认 full-attention looped transformer 的 FLOPs 和 KV-cache 问题。再读第 2 节，重点看 LT2-linear、LT2-sparse 的定义，以及论文如何解释“looping turns compute into context”。Appendix B.1 可以选择性读，主要用于理解线性注意力的 memory refinement 和稀疏注意力的 receptive field expansion。实验部分优先看 hybrid 相关表格和 8k decode throughput，对预训练研究员更有用的是 Full + GDN 与 GDN + DSA 的取舍：前者质量更好，后者更纯粹地去掉二次注意力。最后看 Ouro distillation/continued training 实验，它比从头训练结果更接近真实模型改造场景。

summary_en.core_problem: Looped Transformers reuse a small set of layers for multiple iterations, turning repeated computation into effective depth. The problem is that each iteration still runs full self-attention, so the attention cost and KV-cache footprint grow poorly with sequence length and with the number of loops. LT2 addresses this mismatch: it tries to keep the benefits of looped latent computation while replacing quadratic token mixing with linear or sparse alternatives.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant as an architecture and training-efficiency study rather than a new pretraining objective. It makes looped computation more plausible for long-context and parameter-efficient language models by attacking the attention bottleneck directly. The useful idea is that looping is not just depth reuse: with linear attention it repeatedly refines a recurrent memory state, and with sparse attention it expands the effective receptive field over iterations. The main caveat is scale. The reported results are encouraging, but the behavior at larger model sizes, longer pretraining runs, and more diverse data mixtures is still an open question.
summary_en.technical_approach: LT2 keeps the standard Looped Transformer structure: a set of shared blocks is applied for T iterations before prediction. The change is inside the token mixer. LT2-linear replaces full MHA with a linear-attention primitive, so the recurrent attention state can be updated and refined across loop iterations. LT2-sparse replaces full attention with sparse attention, where repeated application gradually expands the reachable context. The paper also studies hybrid designs. The GDN + DSA hybrid combines linear and sparse attention without any quadratic full-attention layer. The Full + GDN hybrid keeps a small amount of full attention and uses linear attention for the rest, trading a little quadratic cost for better quality. A zero-initialized per-channel learned gate is used to make the replacement more stable.
summary_en.experiments: The main results cover zero-shot evaluation, language modeling, recall, state tracking, and inference efficiency. The GDN + DSA LT2-hybrid matches the standard full-attention Looped Transformer at 59.3% average zero-shot accuracy while reaching about 125 tokens/s at 8k context and batch size 8, compared with 22 tokens/s for the standard looped model, roughly a 5.7x decode-throughput gain. The Full + GDN hybrid improves the average zero-shot score from 59.3% to 61.4%, a 2.1-point gain, while still giving around a 5x throughput improvement in the same setting. The paper also converts a pretrained Ouro looped model into an LT2-style hybrid model with about 1B tokens of continued training. The resulting Ouro-Hybrid-1.4B largely retains the full-attention teacher quality while gaining the LT2 efficiency profile.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with Figure 2 to understand why full-attention looping becomes expensive. Then read Section 2 for the LT2 formulation and the distinction between the linear and sparse variants. The key mechanism is the interaction between looping and the token mixer, not the replacement of attention alone. Appendix B.1 is worth checking if the theoretical explanation of memory refinement and receptive-field growth matters for your work. In the experiments, focus on the hybrid models and the 8k decode-throughput table. The Ouro conversion experiment is especially practical because it tests whether an existing looped full-attention model can be adapted without retraining from scratch.

recommendation.zh: 值得读方法和 LM 表：它检验 loop 是否能弥补 linear/sparse attention 的短板，可作为长上下文架构 ablation 候选。
recommendation.en: Read the method and LM tables: it tests whether looping can offset linear/sparse attention weaknesses, making it a plausible long-context architecture ablation.

paper.title: Simply Stabilizing the Loop via Fully Looped Transformer
paper.abstract: Scaling model performance typically requires increasing model size. Looped Transformer offers a compelling alternative by iteratively reusing the same Transformer blocks, trading additional computation for improved performance without increasing parameter count or context length. Because the number of loop iterations can be adjusted at inference, it also provides a natural mechanism for balancing performance and test-time compute. However, Looped Transformer still suffers from training instabili

summary.core_problem: Looped Transformer 通过复用相同 Transformer 块进行多轮迭代，在不增加参数量的情况下用额外计算换取性能提升，但当循环迭代数增加时会出现训练不稳定甚至崩溃的问题。此前研究未解释这种不稳定性的根本原因。
summary.importance: Looped Transformer 是应对高质量文本数据耗尽、将过剩算力转化为性能增益的潜在方向之一。本文对其训练不稳定性的诊断和解决方法，为测试时缩放（test-time scaling）范式提供了更稳定的基础方案。
summary.technical_approach: 作者通过分析早期训练动态，识别出两种不稳定机制：(1) 梯度振荡——训练早期梯度剧烈波动；(2) 残差爆炸——残差状态范数随循环迭代数快速增长。据此提出 Fully Looped Transformer（FLT），包含两个无额外参数的修改：(1) 全循环架构（Fully Looped Architecture），将循环信号分配到所有层以缓解残差爆炸；(2) 注意力注入（Attention Injection），复用现有注意力模块以受控方式注入循环信息，抑制梯度振荡。
summary.experiments: 诊断实验对比了 6/9/12 轮循环的 Looped Transformer（LT）和 12 轮 FLT 在 2000 步训练窗口内的表现：12 轮 LT 出现训练崩溃（损失停滞在高平台、残差范数持续增长）；9 轮 LT 未崩溃但损失显著高于 6 轮 LT；12 轮 FLT 全程保持稳定，损失下降更平滑、残差范数更小、梯度更稳定。最终实验显示 FLT 在基线 LT 崩溃的训练设置下仍能稳定训练，下游任务平均性能提升最高达 13.2%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节（不稳定诊断）的分析逻辑和图 2 的三个监控指标曲线（训练损失、残差状态范数、梯度 L2 范数）；第 4 节两个无参数修改的具体设计；第 5 节的循环缩放和消融实验。预计阅读时间 20-25 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Looped Transformer improves performance by reusing the same Transformer blocks across multiple iterations without increasing parameter count, but suffers from training instability or collapse when the number of loop iterations increases. Prior work did not explain the root cause of this instability.
summary_en.importance: Looped Transformer is one potential paradigm to address the exhaustion of high-quality text data by converting excess compute into performance gains. The paper's diagnosis and resolution of its training instability provide a more stable foundation for test-time scaling approaches.
summary_en.technical_approach: By analyzing early training dynamics, the authors identify two instability mechanisms: (1) gradient oscillation — violent gradient fluctuations during early training; (2) residual explosion — residual-state norms growing rapidly with loop iterations. The proposed Fully Looped Transformer (FLT) introduces two parameter-free modifications: (1) Fully Looped Architecture, which distributes recurrent signals to all layers to mitigate residual explosion; (2) Attention Injection, which reuses the existing attention block to inject recurrent information in a controlled manner to suppress gradient oscillation.
summary_en.experiments: Diagnostic experiments compared 6/9/12-loop LT and 12-loop FLT over a 2000-step window: 12-loop LT collapsed (loss plateaued at high level, residual norm kept growing); 9-loop LT did not collapse but showed significantly higher loss than 6-loop LT; 12-loop FLT remained stable throughout with smoother loss reduction, smaller residual norms, and more stable gradients. Final experiments show FLT trains stably in regimes where baseline LT collapses, improving downstream task average performance by up to 13.2%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (instability diagnosis) for the analytical logic and Figure 2's three monitoring metrics (training loss, residual-state norm, gradient L2 norm); Section 4 for the two parameter-free modification designs; Section 5 for loop-scaling and ablation experiments. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Looped Transformer 训练不稳定性的架构改进，对探索 Universal Transformer 变体和 test-time compute 架构的研究员有参考价值，重点看其缓解残差爆炸的机制。
recommendation.en: Architectural improvements for training stability in Looped Transformers; valuable for researchers exploring Universal Transformer variants and test-time compute architectures. Focus on its mechanism for mitigating residual explosion.

paper.title: Flash PD-SSM: Memory-Optimized Structured Sparse State-Space Models
paper.abstract: State-space models (SSMs) face a fundamental trade-off between efficiency and expressivity that is mainly dictated by the structure of the model's transition matrix. Unstructured transition matrices enable maximal expressivity, as measured by their ability to model finite-state automaton (FSA) transitions, but come at a prohibitively high compute and memory cost. In contrast, most structured transition matrix forms are highly efficient both in runtime and memory consumption, but suffer from limi

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是结构化稀疏 SSM 的可用性问题。PD-SSM 这类模型在有限状态自动机追踪能力上接近非结构化转移矩阵，但原始实现需要为每个 token 生成输入相关的稀疏转移矩阵，内存开销达到 O(LN^2)，实际速度比 Mamba2 慢很多。Flash PD-SSM 的目标是在保留状态追踪表达力的同时，把训练和推理开销降到接近主流高效 SSM 的水平。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构层。近期混合架构越来越多地用 SSM 层替代部分 attention 层，瓶颈不只是线性复杂度，还包括 SSM 转移矩阵是否能表示复杂状态机。Flash PD-SSM 提供了一个较清楚的取舍：不退回到纯对角矩阵，也不接受非结构化矩阵的成本，而是用结构化稀疏矩阵加硬件友好实现争取表达力和吞吐的平衡。它还给出一个有用信号：单一 SSM 形式未必最合适，Flash PD-SSM 与 DeltaNet 的混合在语言建模上优于纯 Flash PD-SSM 和纯 DeltaNet。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是重做 PD-SSM 中输入相关结构化稀疏矩阵的选择与生成机制。原 PD-SSM 的并行 recurrence 计算虽然是线性的，但矩阵生成阶段需要 O(LN^2) 内存，抵消了结构化稀疏的优势。Flash PD-SSM 把这一部分降到 O(LN)，同时保持原先关于状态追踪能力的理论保证。工程上，作者实现了定制 Triton/CUDA kernel，用于结构化线性 recurrence，避免通用稀疏算子的调度和内存访问损耗。语言模型部分还构造了 Delta-PD，即 Flash PD-SSM 与 DeltaNet 层的混合模型，用 MAD mechanistic capability 的结果辅助决定混合方式，而不是只做单层替换。
summary.experiments: 效率实验显示，在序列长度 5120 下，Flash PD-SSM 训练速度比 DeltaNet 快 18%，比 Mamba2 快 4%，显存比二者都低 12% 以上。合成状态追踪任务上，Flash PD-SSM 平均长度泛化准确率为 96.3%，高于 Mamba2 的 58.9%、Mamba3 的 90.7%、Gated DeltaProduct 的 80.7%。MAD mechanistic capability 测试中，Flash PD-SSM 为 69.2%，接近 Mamba 的 69.3%。自然语言状态追踪方面，作者扩展 Box 数据集到最多 26 次状态转换，在等设置下，Flash PD-SSM 的分布外长度泛化准确率最高比 Mamba2 高 10%。语言建模实验使用 FineWeb100B 进行完整预训练，Delta-PD 的平均准确率为 42.3%，高于纯 Flash PD-SSM 的 38.5% 和纯 DeltaNet 的 41.3%；吞吐为 253k tokens/s，而纯 DeltaNet 为 168k tokens/s，约为 1.5 倍。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。优先看方法部分中矩阵选择机制如何把 O(LN^2) 降到 O(LN)，这是论文的核心。然后看 Section 4.1 的吞吐和显存曲线，判断 kernel 优化带来的实际收益是否足以支撑大规模预训练。状态追踪实验值得看任务设置和长度外推结果，因为它直接对应 SSM 是否能稳定维护离散状态。语言建模部分重点看 Delta-PD 的层混合设计和 FineWeb100B 结果，不必过度关注时间序列任务，除非关心长序列非文本建模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in structured sparse SSMs. PD-SSM has strong finite-state tracking expressivity, close to unstructured transition matrices, but its input-dependent sparse transition generation requires O(LN^2) memory. This makes the original design much slower than production-oriented SSMs such as Mamba2. Flash PD-SSM aims to keep the expressivity benefit while making the layer competitive in throughput and memory.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to pretraining architecture design, especially for hybrid Transformer-SSM models. It makes a useful point: the cost of an SSM layer is not only the asymptotic recurrence, but also how the transition matrix is parameterized, generated, and mapped to hardware. The paper also suggests that hybridizing different efficient sequence layers can be better than choosing a single SSM family. The Delta-PD results indicate that Flash PD-SSM may be more useful as one component in a mixed architecture than as a full replacement for all sequence layers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key change is a new selection mechanism for the structured sparse transition matrices used by PD-SSM. The original PD-SSM recurrence can be evaluated with linear-complexity structured sparse matrix multiplication, but generating the input-dependent matrices costs O(LN^2) memory. Flash PD-SSM reduces this generation cost to O(LN) while retaining the theoretical state-tracking guarantees. The algorithmic change is paired with custom Triton/CUDA kernels for the structured linear recurrence, avoiding the overheads of generic sparse operations. For language modeling, the paper also introduces Delta-PD, a hybrid of Flash PD-SSM and DeltaNet layers, motivated by mechanistic capability tests rather than by a blind layer swap.
summary_en.experiments: At sequence length 5120, Flash PD-SSM trains 18% faster than DeltaNet and 4% faster than Mamba2, with more than 12% lower memory usage than both. On synthetic state-tracking tasks, it reaches 96.3% average length-generalization accuracy, compared with 58.9% for Mamba2, 90.7% for Mamba3, and 80.7% for Gated DeltaProduct. On the MAD mechanistic capability benchmark, it scores 69.2%, close to Mamba at 69.3%. On an extended Box natural-language state-tracking dataset with up to 26 state transitions, it improves out-of-distribution length generalization over Mamba2 by up to 10% in matched settings. In language modeling, the authors pretrain on FineWeb100B. Delta-PD reaches 42.3% average accuracy, above pure Flash PD-SSM at 38.5% and pure DeltaNet at 41.3%, while improving throughput from 168k tokens/s for DeltaNet to 253k tokens/s.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30 to 45 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Focus first on the matrix selection mechanism and the O(LN^2) to O(LN) memory reduction. Then inspect the throughput and memory results in Section 4.1, since the paper depends heavily on the hardware realization. The state-tracking experiments are worth reading because they test a capability that diagonal SSMs often struggle with. For LLM architecture work, the most relevant part is the Delta-PD language modeling setup and its FineWeb100B results. The time-series experiments are less central unless long non-text sequences are a direct concern.

recommendation.zh: 看表达力证明和真实 LM 表；若只赢合成 FSA 就当架构备查，若大规模困惑度也赢才值得复现。
recommendation.en: Check the expressivity proof and real LM tables; if it only wins synthetic FSA tasks, keep it as architecture background, not a pretrain recipe.

paper.title: Toeplitz MLP Mixers are Low Complexity, Information-Rich Sequence Models
paper.abstract: Transformer-based large language models are in some respects limited by the quadratic time and space computational complexity of attention. We introduce the Toeplitz MLP Mixer (TMM), a transformer-like architecture that swaps attention for triangular-masked Toeplitz matrix multiplication over the sequence dimension resulting in $\mathcal{O} (dn \log n)$ time and $\mathcal O(dn)$ space complexity during training and $\mathcal O(dn)$ time and space at inference prefill. Despite the lack of sophist

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个架构问题：能否在不使用注意力的情况下，保留足够强的序列信息访问能力，同时把训练和长 prompt prefill 的复杂度降到次二次。作者认为很多线性复杂度模型的问题不只是 loss，而是信息保留能力不足，尤其体现在 copying、in-context learning 和检索类任务上。
summary.importance: 这篇论文更接近预训练架构研究。它没有沿着 state space model 的常数状态路线走，而是采用结构化 token mixing：用 masked Toeplitz 矩阵替代 attention。它的价值在于提供了一个相对朴素的对照点：不做 token-dependent state update，也不做复杂注意力近似，仅靠相对位置不变的 Toeplitz 混合和 FFT 加速，是否可以获得更好的训练效率与信息保留。这对评估 sub-quadratic LM 架构很有帮助，因为它把问题从“复杂度低”拉回到“低复杂度下还能保留多少输入信息”。
summary.technical_approach: TMM 可以看作 Masked Mixer 的一个受限版本。它在 sequence dimension 上用三角 causal mask 的 Toeplitz 矩阵做 token mixing。Toeplitz 矩阵的特点是同一条对角线共享参数，因此当前位置往前第 k 个 token 的 mixing 权重与绝对位置无关，只与相对距离有关。这个结构可以用 FFT 计算，训练复杂度为 O(d n log n)，空间复杂度为 O(d n)。与 Mamba 这类 state-space 架构相比，TMM 不把历史压缩到常数状态；它仍然允许访问大量历史 token，只是访问权重被 Toeplitz 结构约束。与 attention 相比，它缺少 query-conditioned 的动态路由能力，但计算和显存成本更低。论文的核心取舍就在这里：牺牲输入相关的 pairwise interaction，换取更稳定、信息容量更高的结构化混合。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕两类指标展开。第一类是训练效率：在相近 compute 或 wall-clock 条件下，TMM 相比其他 sub-quadratic 模型达到相近或更低的 evaluation loss，并且设备显存占用更低。第二类是信息保留：作者使用 information extraction、model inversion、copy experiments 和 information retrieval benchmarks 检查模型能否保留输入细节。结论是 TMM 比其他线性或次二次模型保留更多输入信息，并缩小了与二次 attention 模型在 copy ability 上的差距。给定全文片段没有包含具体表格和模型规模，因此不能给出参数量、训练 token 数、loss 差值或 benchmark 分数。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先看 Background and Method，确认 Toeplitz token mixing 如何施加 causal mask，以及 FFT 计算如何对应到复杂度下降。然后看信息保留实验，不要只看语言建模 loss；copy、model inversion 和 retrieval 结果更能说明这个架构与 Mamba/Hyena 类模型的差异。最后看 benchmark 与 loss-per-compute 曲线，判断它是否只是小规模设置下的优势。值得深挖的问题是：Toeplitz 权重是静态的，缺少 query-conditioned 选择；当任务需要内容相关路由时，它的上限可能仍受限。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a language model can avoid attention while preserving enough sequence information for causal modeling. The authors focus on a weakness of many linear-complexity models: their loss can look competitive, but their ability to copy, retrieve, and support in-context behavior is often worse because historical information is compressed too aggressively.
summary_en.importance: This is a pretraining-architecture paper. Its main contribution is not a new training recipe, but a clean architectural alternative to attention and state-space models. Instead of using a constant-size recurrent state or token-dependent state updates, TMM uses structured Toeplitz token mixing. This makes it a useful reference point for sub-quadratic LM research: it tests how far one can go with a simple, information-rich mixing operator before needing dynamic attention-like routing.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Toeplitz MLP Mixer is a masked-mixer architecture where sequence mixing is parameterized by triangular causal Toeplitz matrices. A Toeplitz matrix shares parameters along diagonals, so the mixing weight for a token k positions in the past is invariant to the absolute position. This structure can be computed with FFT-based multiplication, giving O(d n log n) training time and O(d n) memory. Compared with state-space models such as Mamba, TMM does not collapse the history into a constant-size state. Compared with attention, it removes query-conditioned pairwise interactions. The design trade-off is clear: less dynamic content-based routing, but lower complexity and stronger raw information retention than many linear-state alternatives.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate both language-modeling efficiency and information preservation. Under comparable compute or wall-clock settings, TMM is reported to reach similar or lower evaluation loss than other sub-quadratic models, while using less device memory. The paper also uses information extraction, model inversion, copy experiments, and retrieval-style benchmarks to test how much input detail remains accessible. The main finding is that TMM retains more input information than other low-complexity models and narrows the copy-ability gap with quadratic-attention models. The supplied text does not include result tables, so exact parameter counts, token budgets, loss gaps, and benchmark numbers cannot be stated safely.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–40 minutes. Read the method section first to verify how the causal Toeplitz mixer is implemented and how the FFT computation yields the stated complexity. Then prioritize the information-retention experiments over the headline LM loss, because copying, inversion, and retrieval better expose the architectural difference from Mamba-like models. Finally, inspect the loss-per-compute and memory comparisons to see whether the advantage holds beyond small-scale regimes. The main limitation to keep in mind is that static Toeplitz mixing lacks query-conditioned routing, which may cap performance on tasks requiring content-dependent access.

recommendation.zh: 这类 attention 替代架构大多最后输在 setup，不在想法；但这篇若对比足够公平，会动到“ICL 需要 attention”这个 prior，先看复杂度实现、copying 实验和 ICL 对比表。
recommendation.en: Most attention-replacement papers fail on setup rather than idea; if this one is fairly matched, it challenges the prior that ICL needs attention—start with the complexity section, copying results, and the ICL comparison table.

paper.title: UniPool: A Globally Shared Expert Pool for Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Modern Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures allocate expert capacity through a rigid per-layer rule: each transformer layer owns a separate expert set. This convention couples depth scaling with linear expert-parameter growth and assumes that every layer needs isolated expert capacity. However, recent analyses and our routing probe challenge this allocation rule: replacing a deeper layer's learned top-k router with uniform random routing drops downstream accuracy by only 1.0-1.6 points across

summary.core_problem: UniPool 解决的是 MoE 的专家容量分配问题：标准 MoE 把专家绑定到每一层，层数增加会线性增加专家参数，但深层专家和路由可能存在明显冗余。论文把问题从“每层该放多少专家”改成“整个网络共享一个专家预算，哪些层按需访问这些专家”。核心挑战不在共享本身，而在共享后如何避免专家死亡、路由尺度不稳、以及不同层争抢同一专家池导致训练退化。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 MoE 预训练有直接参考价值。它挑战了一个默认设计：专家必须是 layer-private。结果显示，专家容量可以作为全局预算管理，而不必和深度线性绑定。这个贡献的量级不只是压缩参数；它给 MoE scaling 提供了一个新的自由度：在固定激活 FLOPs 下，可以把参数预算从“随层均匀铺开”改成“跨层复用”。如果结果在更大 token 量和更大模型上成立，MoE 的参数扩展曲线会从按层线性增长转向更接近子线性增长。对基座预训练来说，这会影响模型深度、专家数、激活专家数、路由负载均衡 loss 的联合设计。
summary.technical_approach: UniPool 用一个全局共享专家池替代每层私有专家集合。每个 MoE 层仍然保留独立 router，因此不同深度可以学习不同的路由策略；但所有 router 都从同一批专家中选择 top-k 专家。这个设计保留了层条件化 routing，同时允许同一个专家在多个深度被复用。关键改动有两点。第一是 pool-level auxiliary loss。标准 MoE 的负载均衡 loss 在每层内部计算，目标是让该层的私有专家都被使用。共享专家池后，这个目标会变得不合适：某个专家不被某层使用，不代表它是死专家；强迫每一层都覆盖全部共享专家，反而会破坏跨层复用和层级特化。UniPool 改为跨层聚合 token-to-expert 分配，在全局专家池粒度上做负载均衡，只约束专家整体不被饿死。第二是使用 NormRouter。普通 softmax router 在不同层面对同一个大专家池时，hidden state 尺度差异会变成 routing sharpness 差异，训练中容易出现某些层路由过尖或过平。NormRouter 采用 L2 normalization 加 ReLU scoring，并带 learnable scale。归一化降低层间尺度差异，ReLU 在大专家池中提供稀疏竞争，learnable scale 让每层可调节路由强度。与后验专家剪枝或专家合并不同，UniPool 是训练时架构改动，不是训练后的压缩补丁。
summary.experiments: 论文先给出一个重要动机实验：在 Qwen1.5-MoE、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、Qwen3-30B-A3B 三个生产级 MoE 上，把深层某一个 MoE 层的 learned top-k router 替换成 uniform random routing，并在 deep-half 层逐层扫描。平均下游准确率只下降 1.0 到 1.6 个点。这个结果说明，至少在深层同层专家之间，router 对专家身份的精细选择没有预期中那么关键。主实验覆盖五个模型规模，每个模型训练 30B tokens。UniPool 相比 vanilla layer-wise MoE 持续更好；更重要的是，缩小共享专家池后，只使用 vanilla expert-parameter budget 的 41.6% 到 66.7%，仍能匹配或超过标准 MoE。论文还强调 pool-level balancing 与 NormRouter 是配套设计：如果仍使用层内均衡，会强迫每层使用所有共享专家；如果使用普通 softmax router，跨层共享池会放大不同层 logit scale 的不一致。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三处。第一，动机部分和 Table 1：routing randomization probe 是判断这篇工作是否成立的关键证据，需要看它如何选择层、任务和平均方式。第二，方法部分中 pool-level auxiliary loss 的定义：重点看统计量是如何跨层聚合的，是否按 token、层数或 batch 做归一化，以及它和 capacity factor、top-k dispatch 的关系。第三，NormRouter 与共享专家池的消融：这决定 UniPool 是单纯共享参数有效，还是必须依赖 routing/co-design 才稳定。实验部分建议重点看五个 scale 的曲线、减少专家池大小后的质量-参数权衡、每层实际访问专家子集的可视化。如果有路由熵、专家利用率、跨层专家重用矩阵，这些图比单点 benchmark 分数更能说明机制。值得深挖的问题是：共享专家是否学到跨层通用变换，还是只是被不同层以不同输入分布复用；以及在更长训练、更大 token 预算下，共享池是否会出现早期优势消失或专家过度耦合。

summary_en.core_problem: UniPool addresses expert-capacity allocation in MoE Transformers. Standard MoE assigns a private expert set to every layer, so expert parameters grow linearly with depth. The paper argues that this rule is unnecessarily rigid, especially when deeper-layer routing and same-layer experts show substantial redundancy. The goal is to turn expert capacity into a global budget that all layers can access, while keeping layer-specific routing decisions.
summary_en.importance: The work is directly relevant to MoE pretraining design. Its main contribution is not just parameter reduction; it changes a default scaling assumption. Expert capacity does not have to be owned by depth. A shared expert pool creates another scaling axis: depth, active FLOPs, number of routers, and total expert parameters can be adjusted more independently. If the result holds at larger training budgets, it suggests a path toward sublinear expert-parameter growth with depth, which is important for training and serving large sparse models.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniPool replaces layer-private expert sets with a single globally shared expert pool. Each MoE layer still has its own router, so routing remains depth-conditioned, but all routers select from the same pool. Two design choices make this viable. First, the auxiliary load-balancing loss is moved from the layer level to the pool level. In conventional MoE, each layer balances its own private experts to avoid dead experts. With a shared pool, that objective is misaligned: an expert can be unused by one layer but heavily used by others. UniPool aggregates token-to-expert assignments across layers and balances utilization at the level where parameters are actually owned, namely the global pool. Second, the model uses NormRouter rather than a standard softmax router. Since routers at different depths compete over the same larger pool, layer-dependent hidden-state scales can create inconsistent routing sharpness. NormRouter uses L2 normalization, ReLU scoring, and a learnable scale, which reduces scale sensitivity, encourages sparse competition, and lets each layer tune routing strength during training. This differs from post-hoc expert pruning or merging because the sharing is built into pretraining.
summary_en.experiments: The paper first motivates the design with a routing-randomization probe on Qwen1.5-MoE, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Replacing the learned top-k router in a single deep-half MoE layer with uniform random routing reduces downstream accuracy by only 1.0 to 1.6 points on average. This indicates that, in deeper layers, the exact choice among same-layer experts is less critical than the standard architecture assumes. The main experiments train five model scales on 30B tokens. UniPool consistently improves over vanilla layer-wise MoE. Reduced-pool variants using only 41.6% to 66.7% of the vanilla expert-parameter budget still match or outperform the layer-wise baseline. The reported ablations point to a co-design effect: pool-level balancing is needed because layer-level balancing conflicts with cross-layer reuse, while NormRouter stabilizes routing into a shared large pool.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the motivation and Table 1 carefully first. The routing-randomization probe is the empirical basis for questioning layer-private experts. Then focus on the formulation of the pool-level auxiliary loss: how assignments are aggregated across layers, how normalization is handled, and how it interacts with top-k dispatch and capacity constraints. The NormRouter ablation is the next important part, because it separates parameter sharing from routing stability. In the experiments, prioritize the five-scale training results, reduced-pool comparisons, expert-utilization statistics, routing entropy, and any cross-layer expert-reuse visualizations. The most useful follow-up questions are whether shared experts learn genuinely reusable transformations across depth, whether longer training changes the reuse pattern, and whether large-scale MoE pretraining sees expert coupling or specialization collapse.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看 router probe 和共享池消融；若结果站得住，会改变“每层必须有私有专家”的默认架构 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the router probe and shared-pool ablations first; if clean, this weakens the default prior that every MoE layer needs private experts.

paper.title: Cubit: Token Mixer with Kernel Ridge Regression
paper.abstract: Since its introduction in 2017, the Transformer has become one of the most widely adopted architectures in modern deep learning. Despite extensive efforts to improve positional encoding, attention mechanisms, and feed-forward networks, the core token-mixing mechanism in Transformers remains attention. In this work, we show that the attention module in Transformers can be interpreted as performing Nadaraya-Watson regression, where it computes similarities between tokens and aggregates the corresp

summary.core_problem: Cubit 试图替换 Transformer 中的 token mixing 机制：把标准 attention 解释为 Nadaraya–Watson kernel regression，再用带显式正则的 Kernel Ridge Regression 设计新的 mixing 模块，以改善长序列建模和稳定性。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座模型架构研究有一定启发，但还属于早期架构探索。它有价值的地方是给 attention 提供了一个清晰的回归视角，并把“相似度加权平均”推广到“带正则的核回归求解”。如果这种形式能在大规模语言建模中保持可训练性和可扩展性，可能为 attention 之外的 token mixer 提供新路线。主要风险也很明确：KRR 需要求解或近似求解核矩阵线性系统，长上下文下的计算、内存和数值稳定性会成为核心瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 标准 self-attention 可看作 Nadaraya–Watson 回归：query 与 key 计算 kernel 相似度，再对 value 做归一化加权平均。Cubit 把这一步换成 Kernel Ridge Regression。KRR 的预测形式包含 k(x)^T (K + λI)^(-1) Y，其中 K 是 token 间 Gram matrix，λ 是正则项。相比普通 attention 只做局部相似度加权，KRR 会通过全局核矩阵的逆或线性求解考虑 token 之间的相关结构，并用 λ 控制 bias-variance trade-off。论文还加入 Limited-Range Rescale，用于限制数值范围、改善训练稳定性。与 linear attention 或 sparse attention 不同，Cubit 不是近似 softmax attention，而是改变了 token mixing 的统计估计形式。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在不同数据集、序列长度和模型规模上验证了 Cubit，并观察到长序列训练时收益更明显。给出的正文片段没有包含完整实验表格，因此无法可靠列出具体困惑度、准确率或加速数字。可以确定的实验结论是：Cubit 的优势主要出现在更长训练序列中，这与 KRR 利用全局 Gram matrix 建模 token 相关结构的动机一致。需要重点检查的实验点包括：与同规模 Transformer 的公平性、KRR 求解开销、LRR 对稳定性的消融、不同 λ 设置对训练和泛化的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Method 中从 Nadaraya–Watson 到 KRR 的推导，确认 Cubit 与标准 attention 的数学差异。然后看 Limited-Range Rescale 的实现细节，因为这是把 KRR 形式放入深度网络训练时的关键工程处理。实验部分优先看长序列设置、模型规模扩展曲线和消融表。若只关心 LLM 预训练，可重点判断两件事：一是它的复杂度是否能承受万级以上上下文；二是收益是否来自 KRR mixer，而不是调参、归一化或训练预算差异。

summary_en.core_problem: Cubit tries to replace the token-mixing operation in Transformers. It interprets standard attention as Nadaraya–Watson kernel regression and replaces it with a Kernel Ridge Regression mixer with explicit regularization, aiming to improve long-sequence modeling.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful as an architecture idea, but it is still an early-stage alternative to attention. Its main contribution is a clean regression view of token mixing: attention is not only a similarity-weighted average, but one point in a broader family of kernel regression estimators. Moving from Nadaraya–Watson regression to KRR introduces regularization and a global solve over the token Gram matrix. For foundation-model pretraining, the key question is whether this extra structure can scale without unacceptable compute, memory, or numerical costs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Standard self-attention can be written as a Nadaraya–Watson estimator: a query computes kernel similarities to keys and returns a normalized weighted average of values. Cubit replaces this estimator with Kernel Ridge Regression. The KRR prediction has the form k(x)^T (K + λI)^(-1) Y, where K is the Gram matrix over tokens and λ is a regularization coefficient. This changes token mixing from direct similarity averaging to a regularized global regression problem. The regularizer controls the bias-variance trade-off and can improve robustness to noisy or redundant token interactions. The paper also introduces Limited-Range Rescale to keep activations within a trainable numerical range. Unlike sparse or linear attention, Cubit is not mainly an approximation to softmax attention; it changes the estimator behind the mixer.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports validation across datasets, sequence lengths, and model sizes, with larger gains as training sequence length increases. The provided text does not include full result tables, so exact perplexity or accuracy numbers are not stated here. The main empirical claim is that Cubit has stronger long-sequence behavior than a comparable Transformer, consistent with the use of a global Gram-matrix regression structure. The critical ablations to check are the cost of the KRR solve, the contribution of Limited-Range Rescale, sensitivity to the ridge coefficient λ, and whether the comparison uses matched parameter counts and training budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20 to 30 minutes. Read the method derivation from Nadaraya–Watson regression to KRR first; that is where the architectural difference from attention is defined. Then inspect the Limited-Range Rescale mechanism, since it is likely important for stable deep-network training. In the experiments, focus on long-sequence settings, scaling with model size, and ablations over λ and LRR. For LLM pretraining, the two main questions are whether the KRR mixer can handle very long contexts efficiently, and whether the observed gains come from the mixer itself rather than normalization or training-budget differences.

recommendation.zh: 这是少见认真改 token mixer 的工作，但先别急着信“下一代架构”；重点看复杂度、稳定化细节和是否在等算力下赢 Transformer。
recommendation.en: A rare paper that actually changes the token mixer, but do not buy the 'next-gen architecture' claim before checking complexity, stabilization tricks, and matched-compute wins over Transformers.

paper.title: Federation of Experts: Communication Efficient Distributed Inference for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture of experts has emerged as the primary mechanism for making Large Language Models (LLMs) computationally efficient. However, in distributed settings, communicating token embeddings between experts is a significant bottleneck.   We present the novel Federation of Experts (FoE) architecture. FoE restructures the MoE block of a transformer layer into multiple MoE clusters. Each cluster is responsible for only one of the KV heads and expert parallelism is applied between those experts. Betwee

summary.core_problem: 在分布式 MoE 推理中，expert parallelism 需要 all-to-all dispatch/collect，跨节点网络带宽成为主要瓶颈；目标是在不明显损伤生成质量的前提下，把高代价的 all-to-all 通信结构性地限制在更小的局部范围内，从而降低 TTFT/TBT 并提升吞吐。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统/并行策略层面的工作，不属于预训练方法，但对“MoE 架构如何与硬件拓扑共设计”很有现实价值。它给出一种结构性改造：把 MoE block 拆成多个与 KV head 绑定的专家簇，用更便宜的跨簇同步替代全局 all-to-all。对做大规模 MoE 训练/推理的人来说，启发在于：路由空间不必全局共享；把路由约束到局部子空间，可能换来显著的通信收益，而质量损失可控。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Federation of Experts (FoE)：
- 将一个 transformer layer 的注意力与 MoE FFN 重构为 H 个相互独立的 MoE groups/clusters。
- 每个 group 拥有 1/H 的 KV heads 与 1/H 的 experts，并在该 group 内做 expert parallelism；token 在每个 group 内独立选择 k/H 个 experts（per-group routing），而不是在全体 experts 上做一次全局 top-k。
- 各 group 的 post-attention residual 通过一次相对轻量的跨组 all-reduce 求和/同步，形成下一层路由所需的共享输入；但最昂贵的 dispatch/combine（与 k 成正比的 all-to-all）被严格限制在 group 内。
- 设计目标是提高 Local Activation Rate（专家选择在本地 GPU/本节点内解决的比例），尤其在多节点 InfiniBand 场景下减少跨节点 token 迁移。
从实现角度看，它相当于把“专家维度的并行”与“注意力 KV head 的分片”绑定，并用结构约束换取通信可预测性与负载均衡。
summary.experiments:
论文报告在 LongBench 上做端到端推理评测：
- forward-pass latency 最多降低 5.2×
- TTFT 最多降低 3.62×
- TBT 最多降低 1.95×
并声称在相同规模与训练配置下，生成质量与标准 MoE 相当。
摘要与引言还提到：单机可完全消除 all-to-all（因为每组专家都落在同一 GPU 内），多机将 all-to-all 限制在组内，从而把跨节点通信压到更小。精读时需要核对：对比基线的 MoE 具体实现（路由、capacity factor、top-k）、硬件拓扑（节点数/链路）、batch/seq 长度设置，以及“质量相当”的量化指标。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
1) 先看架构图与并行/通信分析：FoE 如何把全局 all-to-all 变成组内 all-to-all + 组间 all-reduce。
2) 再看实验设置：单机 vs 多机的通信量分解、TTFT/TBT 的测量方法、LongBench 的上下文长度与 batch 策略。
预计 20–30 分钟可判断是否适合自家 MoE serving；若要落地，需要进一步看实现细节（路由约束对负载/质量的影响、与现有 EP/TP/PP 的组合方式）。

summary_en.core_problem: Distributed MoE inference is dominated by all-to-all token dispatch/collect in expert parallelism, especially across nodes where network bandwidth is far below intra-node interconnect. The goal is to restructure MoE so expensive communication is localized while preserving generation quality.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference/parallelism paper rather than a pretraining-method contribution, but it is highly relevant for anyone operating large MoE models. The key takeaway is architectural co-design with topology: you can constrain routing to local subspaces (instead of global top-k over all experts) and trade a small structural restriction for large, predictable communication savings.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Federation of Experts (FoE) partitions a transformer layer into H independent MoE clusters:
- Each cluster owns 1/H of the KV heads and 1/H of the experts.
- Routing is performed per cluster: each token selects k/H experts within every cluster, replacing a single global top-k over all experts.
- After attention, clusters synchronize post-attention residuals via a relatively cheap cross-cluster all-reduce (sum), which then feeds routing for the next MoE block.
- The expensive k-proportional all-to-all dispatch/combine is confined within each cluster, increasing the Local Activation Rate and reducing cross-node traffic.
Conceptually, it binds expert partitioning to KV-head partitioning and uses structural constraints to enforce locality and load balance.
summary_en.experiments: On LongBench, they report up to 5.2× reduction in end-to-end forward-pass latency, 3.62× improvement in time-to-first-token, and 1.95× improvement in time-between-tokens, with comparable generation quality to a standard MoE model under the same size/training configuration. For a serious evaluation, you’d want to verify: baseline MoE implementation details (routing, capacity), hardware topology and node count, batch/sequence settings, and how “comparable quality” is quantified.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in this order: (1) the architecture/communication diagrams and the argument turning global all-to-all into intra-cluster all-to-all + inter-cluster all-reduce; (2) the communication breakdown and TTFT/TBT measurement methodology; (3) the quality comparison protocol. ~20–30 minutes to assess fit for a serving stack; more time if you plan to integrate with existing EP/TP/PP setups.

recommendation.zh: MoE推理通信优化的聪明架构方案，将KV头分组与专家路由解耦设计值得一读，对大规模MoE推理部署有实际参考价值
recommendation.en: Clever architecture for MoE inference communication optimization; the KV-head grouping decoupled from expert routing design is worth reading, with practical value for large-scale MoE inference deployment

paper.title: 论文推荐：Parcae Parcae 是一篇
paper.abstract: mocai 关注 论文推荐：Parcae Parcae 是一篇在问题诊断和方法设计上都展现了理论深度的论文。它最大的贡献不是 Parcae 架构本身——负对角参数化虽然优雅，但终究是对角近似——而是将循环架构的研究从"经验工程"提升到了"理论驱动设计"的层面。 动力系统框架的价值不仅在于诊断了不稳定性，更在于它预测了稳定化的收益。一旦你知道不稳定性来自谱半径过大，你就知道约束谱半径后：所有学习率都应该能训练（因为稳定性不再依赖超参数），更大的循环深度应该变得可行（因为系统不会发散），训练和测试时的缩放行为应该变得可预测（因为动力学是可控的）。这些预测都被实验验证了。 缩放定律的建立是另一项重要贡献。在此之前，循环架构的研究者缺乏系统性的缩放指导——应该用多大的 μ_rec？多少训练数据？这些只能靠试错。Parcae 的幂律和指数衰减律提供了初步但可操作的答案。"循环和数据应按幂律同步增长"这一发现如果能在更大规模上验证，将直接影响循环架构的训练策略设计。 统一缩放定律将训练和推理连接成一个整体，这在概念上是优雅的，在实用上是有价值的。它意味着你可以从一个训练配置出发，预测所有可能的推理

summary.core_problem: 文章在解读 Parcae 这篇循环架构工作，关注点不是单一结构技巧，而是如何用动力系统视角解释 RNN 类模型训练不稳定、并据此指导架构与缩放设计。
summary.key_insights: 最有信息量的部分有三点。第一，作者强调 Parcae 的价值主要在“先诊断再设计”：把不稳定性归因到谱半径过大后，就能自然推出约束谱半径、放宽学习率敏感性、支持更深循环层数这些设计方向。第二，文章认为论文提出的缩放规律比具体参数化更重要，因为它给了循环模型在参数、数据、训练配置上的可操作指导，而不是继续靠试错。第三，训练-推理统一缩放这一点被点出来了：如果成立，它意味着可以从训练配置外推不同推理预算下的质量变化，这对部署侧的算力-效果权衡有实际意义。
summary.limits: 这是一篇二手推荐，不是一手实验或源码分析，信息主要来自作者对论文的概括和判断。文章提到的收益是否能在更大规模语言建模中成立，还取决于实验规模、对角参数化的表达上限，以及循环架构在延迟和并行性上的工程约束。对做 LLM 基座的人来说，它更像方法论启发，不足以单独作为技术结论。

summary_en.core_problem: This post discusses Parcae through the lens of recurrent modeling, focusing less on the specific architecture and more on whether dynamical-systems analysis can turn RNN design from heuristic tuning into theory-guided engineering.
summary_en.key_insights: The useful takeaway is the causal chain it highlights: if instability is traced to an oversized spectral radius, then constraining that quantity should reduce learning-rate fragility, make deeper recurrence trainable, and improve predictability across train/test scaling. The post also stresses that Parcae’s scaling laws may matter more than its diagonal parameterization, because they offer practical guidance on how recurrence and data should grow together. A third point is the train-inference unified scaling view, which, if robust, could help estimate quality under different inference budgets from a single training setup.
summary_en.limits: This is still a commentary post rather than primary evidence. It does not add new experiments, implementation details, or failure analysis beyond the paper-level interpretation. For LLM pretraining researchers, the value is mainly conceptual: a useful framing for stability and scaling in recurrent alternatives, but not enough to settle viability at frontier scale.
